theorem regular (C : Family g.core) (hg : g.IsSimple) (h : C.Makes) : WilsonRegularity (wilsonFamily C) := by
  refine ⟨?_,fun N p v x => C.continuousO N p v.1 v.2 x, fun N p v x => C.invariant h N p v.1 v.2 x, ?_⟩
  · refine ⟨2*Pert.Asymptotics.b0 g.core, ?_, fun ε hε => ?_⟩
    · have hc := YM.Gauge.casimir_pos (GaugeGroup.coreSimple hg)
      unfold Pert.Asymptotics.b0
      positivity
    · filter_upwards [Pert.Asymptotics.zeroUp_bound C h hε] with N hN
      exact fun p => hN N p le_rfl
  intro v
  exact ⟨(C.localSection v.1).stencil,fun N p x => C.localO N p v.1 v.2 x⟩

def PositionsUV (C : Family G) (e : Extraction.Sequence) :=
  ∀ (p n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → C.book.Token),
   ∃ f : Points n → ℂ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (NoHit C.S p n) ∧
     (∀ t : Test n, suitable C.S p t → Tendsto (fun j => Order.smears C (e j) p v t) atTop (𝓝 (t.applyTo f))) ∧
     ∀ l : List (Reach n),
       let F N := squall (C.S.a N) l (lifted C N p v)
       let g := derive f (l.map Reach.where_)
       Cluster C e p n F g ∧
       Meets (NoHit C.S p n) (fun j => interpolated C.S (e j) (F (e j))) g ∧
       ∀ t : Test n, suitable C.S p t →
         Integrable (fun x : Points n => t x * g x) ∧
         Tendsto (fun j => sumOn F C.S p (e j) t) atTop (𝓝 (t.applyTo g))
ends.conclusion: `PositionsUV` gives, for every volume `p`, token list `v` and difference list `l`, a limiting kernel `f` (and its derivative `g`) such that the smeared lattice correlations converge along the full sequence for every `suitable` separated test.

theorem wilsonLimit {s : Extraction.Sequence} (h : (Extraction.Order.mk .full s).Ordered C S) :
    (wilsonFamily C).Converges s (fun v => (hierarchy F Q).correlation none ((hierarchy F Q).project ∘ v)) := by
  intro n v t
  obtain ⟨hv,row,hr,hl⟩ := fromWilson C h n v t
  refine ⟨hv,row,hr,?_⟩
  convert hl using 2
  congr 1
  funext x
  change t x * S.useAt S x (S.classTokens ∘ v) = t x * S.read x v
  by_cases hx : x ∈ conf n
  · rw [S.at_project S F.room.kernel.laws.toSymmetric (fun _ => le_rfl) hx]
  · have hz : t x = 0 := notMem_support.mp (fun h => hx (t.tsupport_subset (subset_closure h)))
    simp [hz]
ends.conclusion: `wilsonLimit` identifies the lattice limit with `correlation none (project ∘ v)` using `S.at_project` on `conf n`, and separated tests vanish off `conf n`.

  have ha : AnalyticAt ℝ (bring H d B) 0 := AnalyticAt.pi fun i => hp.shot (B i)

  let L : GaugePanel G m ≃ₗ[ℝ] PanelL2 G m := transport
  let T := L.toLinearMap.comp D.toLinearMap
  have commute (u : G.El) (y : GaugePanel G m) : L (rotates u y) = rotateIso u (L y) := rfl
  have ht (u : G.El) (x : Snap G d) : T (Cast u x) = rotateIso u (T x) := by

  refine ⟨C.comp L.toLinearMap, fun x => hc x, ?_⟩
  intro u y

  rw [commute, he]

private lemma deriv_comm (H : Hol G) (B : Fin m → Slot) (hp : Peg H d)
    (hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (bring H d B) 0) (u : G.El) (x : Snap G d) :
    fderiv ℝ (bring H d B) 0 (Cast u x) = rotates u (fderiv ℝ (bring H d B) 0 x) := by
  let F := bring H d B
  let D := fderiv ℝ F 0
  let P : Snap G d →L[ℝ] Snap G d := castL u
  let Q : GaugePanel G m →L[ℝ] GaugePanel G m := rotatesL u
  have ha : HasFDerivAt F D (P 0) := by rw [map_zero]; exact hd.hasFDerivAt
  have ha' : HasFDerivAt (F ∘ P) (D.comp P) 0 := ha.comp 0 P.hasFDerivAt
  have hb : HasFDerivAt (Q ∘ F) (Q.comp D) 0 := Q.hasFDerivAt.comp 0 hd.hasFDerivAt
  have eqn : F ∘ P = Q ∘ F := funext fun a => funext fun i => hp.observes (B i) u a
  rw [eqn] at ha'
  change D.comp P x = Q.comp D x
  rw [ha'.unique hb]

private lemma hammered {X Y ι : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℝ X] [CompleteSpace X] [NormedAddCommGroup Y] [NormedSpace ℝ Y] [CompleteSpace Y]
    (f : X → Y) (C : Y →L[ℝ] X) (h : AnalyticAt ℝ f 0) (hh : C.comp (fderiv ℝ f 0)=ContinuousLinearMap.id _ _) (hz : f 0=0) (p : ι → X → X) (q : ι → Y → Y)
    (hx : ∀ i,Tendsto (p i) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 0)) (hy : ∀ i,Tendsto (q i) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 0)) (HP : ∀ i x,f (p i x)=q i (f x)) (HQ : ∀ i x,C (q i x)=p i (C x)) : ∃ F : Y → X,
      AnalyticAt ℝ F 0 ∧ F 0=0 ∧ (∀ᶠ i in 𝓝 0,F (f i)=i) ∧ ∀ u,∀ᶠ i in 𝓝 0,F (q u i)=p u (F i) := by
  let g := C ∘ f
  have hg : ContDiffAt ℝ ω g 0 := ((C.analyticAt _).comp h).contDiffAt
  have ha : HasFDerivAt g (ContinuousLinearEquiv.refl ℝ X).toContinuousLinearMap 0 := by
    rw [show (ContinuousLinearEquiv.refl ℝ X).toContinuousLinearMap= C.comp (fderiv ℝ f 0) from hh.symm]
    exact C.hasFDerivAt.comp 0 h.differentiableAt.hasFDerivAt
  let t := hg.toOpenPartialHomeomorph _ ha (by simp)
  have hw : ContDiffAt ℝ ω t.symm (g 0) := hg.to_localInverse ha (show ω≠(0:WithTop ℕ∞) by simp)
  have hT : g 0=0:=by simp [g,hz]
  have hs : (0:X)∈t.source:=ContDiffAt.mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_source ..
  have ht : t.symm (0:X)=0 := by nth_rw 1 [← hT]; exact t.left_inv hs
  rw [hT] at hw
  let F := t.symm ∘ C
  have hi : F 0=0 := by simp [F,ht]
  have hq := (show AnalyticAt ℝ (t.symm) (C 0) from by rw [map_zero]; exact hw.analyticAt) |>.comp (C.analyticAt _)
  refine ⟨F,hq,hi,?_,fun i => ?_⟩
  · filter_upwards [t.open_source.mem_nhds hs] with i hh; exact t.left_inv hh
  have he : 0∈t.target:= hT ▸ t.map_source hs
  have hl : Tendsto F (𝓝 0) (𝓝 0) := by simpa only [hi] using (show ContinuousAt F 0 from hq.continuousAt).tendsto
  have hu := t.open_source.mem_nhds hs
  have hH := t.open_target.mem_nhds he
  have hw : Tendsto C (𝓝 0) (𝓝 0) := by simpa only [map_zero] using C.continuous.tendsto 0
  filter_upwards [(hl.comp (hy i)).eventually hu,((hx i).comp hl).eventually hu,hw.eventually hH,(hw.comp (hy i)).eventually hH] with x ht hs he hb
  apply t.injOn ht hs
  change t (t.symm (C (q i x))) = g (p i (F x))
  rw [t.right_inv (show C (q i x) ∈ t.target from hb), show g (p i (F x))=p i (t (t.symm (C x))) from by
    change C (f _)=p i (C (f (F x)))
    rw [HP,HQ], t.right_inv he]
  exact HQ _ _

lemma min_cov {h : n → G.El} (hs : A.Solves h) (x : n) (k : G.El) :
    ∑ y, ∑ l, A.term h x y l ≤ ∑ y, ∑ l, G.price (k * A.W x y l * (h y)⁻¹) := by
  classical
  let g := update h x k
  let t (p : n → G.El) i j := ∑ l, A.term p i j l
  let M := Finset.univ.erase x
  have hn : 0 < (Fintype.card n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
  have hm : 0 < (Fintype.card L : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
  have eq (p : n → G.El) : A.cost p = (Fintype.card n:ℝ)⁻¹ * (Fintype.card n:ℝ)⁻¹ * (Fintype.card L:ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, ∑ j, t p i j := by
    simp only [cost,avg, smul_eq_mul,← Finset.mul_sum,t,mul_assoc]
  have eq' (p : n → G.El) : (∑ i, ∑ j, t p i j) = (∑ i ∈ M, ∑ j ∈ M, t p i j) + 2*(∑ i, t p x i) := by
    calc
      _ = (∑ i ∈ M, ∑ j, t p i j) + ∑ j, t p x j := by rw [Finset.sum_erase_add _ _ (Finset.mem_univ x)]
      _ = (∑ i ∈ M, ((∑ j ∈ M, t p i j)+t p i x)) + ∑ j, t p x j := by
        unfold M; simp
      _ = _ := by
        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        have he : (∑ i ∈ M, t p i x) = ∑ i, t p x i := by
          rw [← Finset.sum_erase_add _ _ (Finset.mem_univ x), show t p x x = 0 by simp [t, term,A.same], add_zero]
          exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ A.opposite p _ _
        rw [he]; ring
  have he := hs g
  rw [eq,eq, mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ (by positivity), eq', eq'] at he
  have hh (i) (hi : i ∈ M) : g i = h i := update_of_ne (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hi) ..
  have hd (i) (hi : i ∈ M) (j) (hj : j ∈ M) : t h i j = t g i j := by simp only [t, term, hh i hi, hh j hj]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i hi ↦ Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j hj ↦ hd i hi j hj,
    add_le_add_iff_left,mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ (by positivity)] at he
  apply he.trans
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => ?_
  unfold term g
  by_cases h' : i = x
  · subst i
    simp only [update_self, A.same,mul_one,mul_inv_cancel, G.price_one]
    exact (G.price_range _).1
  simp [h']

  intro T P

  calc
    _ = T.transpose*(probe S).transpose*K H'+ P.transpose*(S.kernel.penalty • P) := by
      rw [Matrix.mul_assoc _ (K H) T,← Matrix.mul_smul,(show K H*T = _ from (stationed F W H H' i).2),Matrix.mul_assoc]

    _ = _ := by unfold P; rw [transpose_sub,transpose_mul,add_sub_cancel]; simp

  let F := uncurry (fun x u => plant S y (x,u)) (α:=In G f)
  have hk : ContDiffAt ℝ ω F (0,a 0) := by
    refine contDiffAt_pi.mpr fun v => ?_
    unfold F uncurry plant
    dsimp only
    split
    · exact ((contDiffAt_apply ℝ G.Mat v _).comp ((0:In G f),a 0) contDiffAt_snd).sub contDiffAt_const
    apply ((contDiffAt_apply ℝ G.Mat v _).comp ((0:In G f),a 0) contDiffAt_snd).sub
    have hh : ContDiffAt ℝ ω (fun x => G.mat (G.focus x)) (cloud S y (0,a 0) v)  :=
      by rw [show cloud _ _ _ _=1 from cloud_zero S y t (h:=h) _]; exact G.focus_diff
    exact hh.comp (f:=fun p => cloud S y p v) ((0:In G f),a 0) (cloud_form S y v (a 0))
  have hx : ∀ᶠ x : In G f in 𝓝 0,F (x,a x)=0 := by
    filter_upwards [roots S y t (G:=G), eventually_all.mpr (stars S y t (h:=h))] with x hx hh
    funext i; change plant _ _ _ _=_; unfold plant; split
    next hi => rw [hi]; simp [a,hx]
    exact sub_eq_zero.mpr (hh i)
  refine (contDiffAt_apply ℝ G.Mat i _).comp 0 (authored a F 0 hx (continuousAt_pi.mpr fun i => hat_cont S y t (h:=h) i) hk fun u H => ?_)
ends.conclusion: The frame choice `hats` is real analytic near 0: the self-consistency equation `plant` (a nearest-point fixed point of the averaged `cloud`) is analytic and the real-analytic implicit function lemma `authored` applies with a trivial-kernel derivative.

lemma link_bound (S : StepData c f) (h : S.patch.Branches S.kernel G)
    (H : Forest S.ratio) (k : S.Choices) (x : Dir G f)
    (hx : ∀ e ∈ H.trunks, collect G x e = 0)
    (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (e : Bond f)
    (hcops : ∀ U : Config G f, Stores.SliceSet S H U → usable S U (S.ratio.parent e.1) k →
      Cops (S := S) U 1 (S.prediction U k) e C) :
    ‖collect G x e‖ ≤ C * (∑ z ∈ box (macroR S.patch), ∑ p : PlaqAxes,
      ‖dColor G f 1 x (wrap f z + S.ratio.embed (S.ratio.parent e.1), plaquette p)‖) +
      ‖bills S x (S.ratio.parent e.1, coord e.2)‖ := by
  let U := fun t : ℝ => represent (t • x)
  have hu : U 0 = 1 := by simp [U]
  let i := S.ratio.parent e.1
  let edge : Bond c := (i, e.2)
  let loc := fun z : Cover => wrap f z + S.ratio.embed i
  let X := box (macroR S.patch)
  have he := chord_limit (U := fun t => U t e) (by rw [hu]; rfl) (represent_deriv x e)
  have hp := chord_limit (U := fun t => S.prediction (U t) k edge)
    (by rw [hu]; exact Push.settled S h edge k) (Push.prices S h edge k x)
  have hs (z : Cover) (p : PlaqAxes) :
      Tendsto (fun t => ‖t‖⁻¹ * G.chord (faceValue (U t) (loc z,p)))
        (𝓝[≠] (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 ‖dColor G f 1 x (loc z, plaquette p)‖) := by
    apply chord_limit
    · unfold U faceValue; rw [zero_smul]; exact Push.stroll_zero _ _
    · rw [← fundamental]; exact Push.travell _ _ _
  have ht : Tendsto (fun t => ∑ z ∈ X, ∑ p : PlaqAxes,
      ‖t‖⁻¹ * G.chord (faceValue (U t) (loc z,p))) (𝓝[≠] (0 : ℝ))
        (𝓝 (∑ z ∈ X, ∑ p : PlaqAxes, ‖dColor G f 1 x (loc z,plaquette p)‖)) := by
    apply tendsto_finsetSum; intro z _; exact tendsto_finsetSum _ fun p _ => hs z p
  apply le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto he ((ht.const_mul C).add hp)
  filter_upwards [(usable_near S x k i).filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds] with t ht'
  have htree : Stores.SliceSet S H (U t) := by
    intro u hub
    change G.lieExp (t • (collect G x u)) * (1:G.El) = _
    rw [hx u hub, smul_zero, G.mat_lieExp_zero, mul_one]
  have ha := hcops (U t) htree ht'
  have ha' : G.chord ((U t) e) ≤ C * port S i (U t) + G.chord (S.prediction (U t) k edge) := by
    unfold Cops at ha
    simp only [replica_one, wire, Pi.one_apply, inv_one, mul_one, one_mul, G.chord_inv] at ha
    split at ha
    · exact ha.trans (add_le_add_right (G.chord_nonneg _) _)
    · exact ha
  change ‖t‖⁻¹ * G.chord ((U t) e) ≤ C * (∑ z ∈ X, ∑ p : PlaqAxes,
    ‖t‖⁻¹ * G.chord (faceValue (U t) (loc z,p))) + ‖t‖⁻¹ * G.chord (S.prediction (U t) k edge)
  have hh := ha'.trans (add_le_add_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (port_le S (U t) i) hC) _)
  apply (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hh (show 0 ≤ ‖t‖⁻¹ by positivity)).trans_eq
  simp only [mul_add, mul_left_comm ‖t‖⁻¹ C, Finset.mul_sum, X, loc]

    _ ≤ _ := by linarith only [hi]

have hsmall (i : Cell f) (hi : i ∈ A.costs \ K) : a / 128 * t ^ 2 ≤ F i := by
    let v := T.Mv (till x) (temp x) V (i,false)
    obtain ⟨hi, hk⟩ := mem_sdiff.mp hi
    have hu : toll U i ≤ t := le_of_not_gt fun h =>
      hk (mem_filter.mpr ⟨hi, h⟩)
    have hm : t/4 ≤ toll U i := (p.consumes i (fun h =>
      disjoint_left.mp h (cost_at_home hi _) (base_mem_start ..))).1 hi
    have hd : Real.sqrt a * t / 8 ≤ Real.sqrt a * toll U i - ‖v‖ := by
      have he : ‖v‖ ≤ Real.sqrt a / 8 * t :=
        (M (i,false)).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hquad ht)
      have hx : Real.sqrt a * (t/4) ≤ Real.sqrt a * toll U i :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hm (Real.sqrt_nonneg a)
      linarith only [he, hx]
    refine le_trans ?_ (square_direct T U V x t i hu)
    change _ ≤ (Real.sqrt a * toll U i - ‖v‖)^2 / 2
    have eq : (Real.sqrt a * t / 8)^2 / 2 = a / 128 * t^2 := by
      rw [div_pow, mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt ac]; ring
    rw [← eq]
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hd 2) (by norm_num)
  have hlarge (i : Cell f) (hi : i ∈ K) : 3/4*b*t*toll U i ≤ F i := by
    let y := Pressure.shoot T.high U i
    let v := T.Mv (till x) (temp x) V (i,false)
    let r := toll U i
    have he : t < r := (mem_filter.mp hi).2
    have hr : ‖v‖ * ‖y‖ ≤ ε * t * (Real.sqrt a * r) :=
      mul_le_mul (M (i,false)) (shoot_norm T U i) (norm_nonneg _) ((norm_nonneg _).trans (M (i,false)))
    have hx : inner ℝ v y ≤ b / 4 * t * r := calc
      _ ≤ ‖v‖ * ‖y‖ := real_inner_le_norm ..
      _ ≤ ε * t * (Real.sqrt a * r) := hr
      _ = (ε * Real.sqrt a) * (t*r) := by ring
      _ ≤ b / 4 * (t*r) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hlin (mul_nonneg ht' (toll_nonneg ..))
      _ = b / 4 * t * r := by ring
    change 3/4*b*t*r ≤ PathData.clipped T.high t r + ‖v‖^2 / 2 - inner ℝ v y
    rw [PathData.clipped, if_neg (not_le.mpr he)]
    change 3/4*b*t*r ≤ b*t*r + ‖v‖^2 / 2 - inner ℝ v y

private lemma dropped_cost (T : Tube G S) (A : Stores S) {x C w : ℝ}
    {U : Config G f} {k : S.Choices} {V : Config G c} (p : A.Plot U k V x w)
    (ht : 0 < fiery G x S.patch.L)
    (E : LaneCounts T.up x (fiery G x S.patch.L) T.high C 1 S.ratio.parent) :
    let t := fiery G x S.patch.L
    ((droppedRows T A x t U).card : ℝ) * t ≤
      cloudPrice T.high.relaxation * ∑ j ∈ A.swell U t, toll U j := by
  intro t
  let K := A.swell U t
  let X := droppedRows T A x t U
  let F (j : Cell f) := clouds j.1 T.high.relaxation (toll U j / t)
  have sub : X ⊆ K.biUnion F := by
    intro i hi
    obtain ⟨hi, hd⟩ : i ∈ A.limit x ∧ ¬ PathData.kept T.high t i.1 U := mem_filter.mp hi

    push Not at hd

    obtain ⟨hh, hs⟩ := cloud_mem (T := T) (U := U) (i := i) (j := j) ht hj
    exact mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨j, in_swell p ht.le (limit_reach hi (E.dropped U i.1 j hj)) hh, hs⟩
  have ha : X.card ≤ ∑ j ∈ K, (F j).card := (card_le_card sub).trans card_biUnion_le
  have hc : (X.card : ℝ) ≤ ∑ j ∈ K, ((F j).card : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast ha
  change (X.card : ℝ) * t ≤ cloudPrice T.high.relaxation * ∑ j ∈ K, _
  refine le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc (show 0 ≤ t from ht.le)) ?_
  rw [sum_mul, mul_sum]
  apply sum_le_sum
  intro j hj
  have hu : t < toll U j := (mem_filter.mp (show j ∈ A.swell U t from hj)).2
  have ht' : 0 < t := ht
  refine (le_div_iff₀ ht').mp ?_
  rw [mul_div_assoc]
  exact cloud_size _ ((one_le_div ht').mpr hu.le) T.high.radius_pos.le

private lemma cloud_size (a : Site f) {y R : ℝ} (hy : 1 ≤ y) (hr : 0 ≤ R) :
    ((clouds a R y).card : ℝ) ≤ cloudPrice R * y := by
  let r := Nat.floor (Real.log y * R)
  have hf : (r : ℝ) ≤ Real.log y * R := Nat.floor_le (mul_nonneg (Real.log_nonneg hy) hr)
  have he : (r : ℝ) + r + 1 ≤ (8*R+1) * Real.exp (Real.log y / 4) := by
    have h := Real.add_one_le_exp (Real.log y / 4)
    have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h hr
    nlinarith only [h, h1, hf, hr, Real.log_nonneg hy]
  have hp : Real.exp (Real.log y / 4) ^ 4 = y := calc
    _ = Real.exp (((4:ℕ):ℝ) * (Real.log y / 4)) := (Real.exp_nat_mul _ _).symm
    _ = _ := by norm_num; rw [show (4:ℝ) * (Real.log y / 4) = Real.log y by ring,
      Real.exp_log (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hy)]
  have hn : (clouds a R y).card ≤ ((r+r+1)^4) * Fintype.card PlaqAxes := by
    unfold clouds
    rw [card_product, card_univ]
    apply Nat.mul_le_mul_right
    simpa using Corona.halo_size ({a} : Support f) r
  calc
    ((clouds a R y).card : ℝ) ≤ ((r:ℝ) + r + 1)^4 * (Fintype.card PlaqAxes : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast hn
    _ ≤ ((8*R+1) * Real.exp (Real.log y / 4))^4 * (Fintype.card PlaqAxes : ℝ) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) he 4) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    _ = cloudPrice R * y := by rw [mul_pow, hp]; unfold cloudPrice; ring
ends.conclusion: The number of sites within `R log y` of a point is at most `cloudPrice R * y` (the count `(1+R log y)^4 <= C y`).

  have hp p : f' p ≤ Y^j*b p := by

lemma alarm_bills (P : Teller G) (L : Side) {η r Q Y ξ : ℝ} (k : ℝ) (hξ : 0<ξ) :
    ∃ E, Rate G L k E ∧ ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop,
    0≤ E x ∧ ∀ (c f : Side) (S : StepData c f) (T : Tube G S) (F : Forest S.ratio)

       ∀ v : Finset (WarningAt c f), X.dice.real (X.catastrophe ξ R.beta v) ≤ (E x)^v.card := by
  let p := Delay.fineMonitor G L
  let H (x : ℝ) := p x ^ ((1:ℝ)/2)
  let B x := radiusB x; let ε := ξ/4
  let u := Census.tubularPrice G L; let W := warning_count L
  let M := payE η r Q u; let V (x : ℝ) := Animals.ballCost (2*B x)
  let E (x : ℝ) := (V x:ℝ)* (u:ℝ)*2*Real.exp (-H x*ε)
  have hp : Rate G L k (fun x=>Real.exp (-H x*ε)) := by
    refine (Rate.monitor_cutoff (show 0< ε by unfold ε; positivity) (show (0:ℝ) < 1/2 by norm_num)).congr
      (Eventually.of_forall (fun x => ?_))
    exact congr_arg Real.exp (show -H x*ε=-ε*H x by ring)
  have he := Census.width_rate G L 2 0; simp only [add_zero] at he
  refine ⟨E,(by convert (((he.mul_right u).mul_right 2).mul hp) using 1
                linarith),?_⟩
  obtain ⟨A,hA,h⟩ := width_bound G L 2 0
  simp only [add_zero] at h
  have hε : 0<ε := by unfold ε; positivity
  filter_upwards [Delay.monitor_pays G L 4 (show 0≤ A*(W:ℝ) by positivity) (show (0:ℝ)<1/2 by norm_num),
    Delay.monitor_pays G L 0 (show 0≤ |M|/ε by positivity) zero_lt_one] with x hx hy
  have hf : V x ≤ A*Delay.bill G L x^4 := h _
  have hv : 0 < H x := by unfold H; exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (Delay.monitor_pos ..) _
  refine ⟨(by unfold E; positivity),?_⟩; intro c f S T F X hg hL hR R hr v
  subst x
  let x := X.x
  have ht : H X.x*H X.x=p X.x := by unfold H; rw [← Real.rpow_add (Delay.monitor_pos ..)]; norm_num; rfl
  unfold dice catastrophe
  unfold E; rw [show -H X.x*ε=-(ε*H X.x) by ring]
  refine Poll.shattered _ _ _ hR.fullC.posSemidef (fun v => (le_abs_self _).trans
    (Control.top (hR.scale.mate X.shutter) hR.full.prices.le v)) (by unfold u; rw [← hL]; exact entering S) (p:=u) (m:=W)
      (by unfold W; rw [← hL]; exact staffed S) v (2*X.B) (by positivity) ?_
  have hm : M/2 ≤ ε*p X.x := by
    rw [pow_zero,mul_one,Real.rpow_one] at hy
    have he := (div_le_iff₀ hε).mp hy
    have hv : 0 ≤ p X.x := (Delay.monitor_pos ..).le
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hε.le hv, le_abs_self M]
  have hz : ε*H X.x *((V X.x:ℝ)*W) ≤ ε*p X.x := by
    have hp : (V X.x:ℝ)*W ≤ H X.x := (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hf (Nat.cast_nonneg W)).trans
      ((le_of_eq (by ring : A*Delay.bill G L X.x^4 * (W:ℝ) = A*(W:ℝ)*Delay.bill G L X.x^4)).trans hx)
    rw [← ht]; refine (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp (by positivity : 0 ≤ ε*H X.x)).trans_eq (by ring)
  apply (add_le_add hm hz).trans
  have hp := charge_area S X.x T R hr
  change Delay.fineMonitor G S.patch.L X.x /2 ≤ X.t*(gStep R.beta)⁻¹ at hp
  rw [hL] at hp

theorem buys_loop (t : LoopPrices) (a : Levels G) (h : Paid I a) (m : ℕ) :
    let j := a.clock.J (m+1)

    let L := a.S.block m

    t.send j i / (L.val:ℝ)^2 ≤ 1/4 →
      t.cost j i (L.val:ℝ) (a.clock.loopCap (m+1)) ≤ a.clock.loopCap m := by
  intro j i L hg hq
  have he := h.theta
  let x := a.clock.hatBeta m
  let y := a.clock.hatBeta (m+1)

  have hx : a.clock.loopCap m = 2 * mon x ^ T.theta i := by rw [Calendar.loopCap, he]; rfl

lemma reachable_chord (G : Gauge) [Nontrivial G.Color] :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ h ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) ε, ∃ u : G.El, G.chord u = h := by
  obtain ⟨c,hc⟩ := exists_ne (0:G.Color)
  let γ (t : ℝ) := G.lieExp (t • c)
  obtain ⟨t,ht⟩ : ∃ t : ℝ, 0 < G.chord (γ t) := by
    by_contra! ha
    have hz : (fun t => G.curvature (γ t)) = fun _ => 0 := funext fun t => norm_le_zero_iff.mp <|
      (G.curvature_norm _).trans (ha t)
    have hd : HasDerivAt (fun t => G.curvature (γ t)) c 0 := G.leading_curvature c
    rw [hz] at hd
    exact hc (hd.unique (hasDerivAt_const _ _))
  have hg : Continuous (fun t => G.chord (γ t)) := G.continuous_chord.comp (G.lieExp_cont.comp (by fun_prop))
  refine ⟨_,ht,fun h hh => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨x,hx⟩ := intermediate_value_univ 0 t hg (show h ∈ Icc (G.chord (γ 0)) _ by simpa [γ] using hh)
  exact ⟨γ x,hx⟩

private lemma mayer_sum (f : Finset ℕ → ℝ) (l : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hf : Summable (fun i => ‖f i‖)) (hl : Summable l) :
    HasSum (fun c : Finset (ℕ ⊕ ℕ) => f c.toLeft * (∏ i ∈ c.toRight, (Real.exp (l i) - 1)))
      ((∑' b, f b) * Real.exp (∑' i, l i)) := by
  let y := fun i => Real.exp (l i) - 1
  let g := fun b : Finset ℕ => ∏ i ∈ b, y i
  have hy : Summable y := by
    refine (hl.norm.mul_left 2).of_norm_bounded_eventually ?_
    filter_upwards [hl.norm.tendsto_cofinite_zero.eventually_le_const zero_lt_one] with i hi
    change ‖Real.exp (l i) - 1‖ ≤ 2 * ‖l i‖
    simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs] at hi ⊢
    exact Real.abs_exp_sub_one_le hi
  have hg : Summable g := summable_finsetProd_of_summable_norm hy.norm
  have hlog : Real.exp (∑' i, l i) = ∑' b, g b := by
    have hy' : (Real.exp ∘ l) = (fun i => 1 + y i) := by
      ext i
      change Real.exp (l i) = 1 + (Real.exp (l i) - 1)
      ring
    calc
      _ = ∏' i, (Real.exp ∘ l) i := hl.hasSum.rexp.tprod_eq.symm
      _ = ∏' i, (1 + y i) := by rw [hy']
      _ = _ := tprod_one_add hg
  let e : Finset Ovens.Label ≃ Finset ℕ × Finset ℕ := Finset.sumEquiv.toEquiv
  let p := fun b : Finset ℕ × Finset ℕ => f b.1 * g b.2
  have hp : HasSum p ((∑' b, f b) * Real.exp (∑' i, l i)) := by
    rw [hlog, tsum_mul_tsum_of_summable_norm hf hg.norm]
    exact (summable_mul_of_summable_norm hf hg.norm).hasSum
  have hz := (e.hasSum_iff (f := p)).mpr hp
  exact hz
ends.conclusion: Expansion `exp(sum l) = prod(1+(e^l-1))` gives the sum over pairs (selection, selection of exponentials).

lemma linear_snapshot (h:Rebar p f c) (hp:1<p) : ∃ L : (smear p).range →L[ℝ] E, ‖L‖≤ c ∧∀ w:Rung,L ((smear p).rangeRestrict w)= trace w f:=by
  let P:=smear p; let F:Rung →ₗ[ℝ] E:= Finsupp.linearCombination ℝ (fun i:sun=> f i.val)
  have hB (w:Rung):‖F w‖≤ c*‖P w‖ := by
    rw [mul_comm]; apply h.beam w; intro i
    have hh:(P w) i=trace w (fun x=>(x/p)^i):=by
      unfold P smear trace; simp_rw [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply,Finsupp.sum,lp.coeFn_sum,Finset.sum_apply,lp.coeFn_smul,Pi.smul_apply,fil hp]
    rw [← hh]; exact lp.norm_apply_le_norm (by simp) _ _
  let g:= P.rangeRestrict
  obtain ⟨b,hb⟩:= LinearMap.exists_rightInverse_of_surjective g (LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr P.surjective_rangeRestrict)
  have hh x: P (b x) = x.val:= congr_arg Subtype.val (DFunLike.congr_fun hb x)
  let L:= F.comp b
  have hk x: ‖L x‖≤ c*‖x‖ := (hB _).trans_eq (congr_arg (fun x'=>c*‖x'‖) (hh x))
  refine ⟨L.mkContinuous c hk, LinearMap.mkContinuous_norm_le _ h.nonneg hk,?_⟩
  intro w; change F (b (g w))=F w; have he:= hB (b (g w)-w); rw [map_sub,map_sub,hh] at he; rw [show (g w).val=P w from rfl, sub_self,norm_zero,mul_zero] at he; exact sub_eq_zero.mp (norm_le_zero_iff.mp he)

    intro ε he
    let t:= min (ε/2) 1 / 2; have ht:0<t:= half_pos (lt_min (half_pos he) zero_lt_one)
    have h₁:t≤1:= (half_le_self ((lt_min (half_pos he) zero_lt_one).le)).trans (min_le_right ..)
    have h₂:t<ε:= ((half_le_self ((lt_min (half_pos he) zero_lt_one).le)).trans (min_le_left ..)).trans_lt (half_lt_self he)

    refine ⟨w,(spans p).smul_mem _ ((spans p).sub_mem (holds hp s) ((spans p).sum_mem fun i hi=> (spans p).smul_mem _ (ih _ (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)))),?_⟩
    rw [dist_eq_norm]; refine lt_of_le_of_lt (b:=t) (lp.norm_le_of_forall_le ht.le fun j=>?_) h₂
    have hp₁: (∑ i∈ Finset.range n,r^i • single i:Wire) j=(if j<n then r^j else 0):=by
      rw [lp.coeFn_sum,Finset.sum_apply]; simp only [lp.coeFn_smul, Pi.smul_apply,smul_eq_mul,single,lp.single_apply,Pi.single_apply]; simp
    unfold w; rw [lp.coeFn_sub,Pi.sub_apply, lp.coeFn_smul, Pi.smul_apply,lp.coeFn_sub,Pi.sub_apply,hp₁]; rw [single,lp.single_apply,fil hp]

private theorem max_end (g : ℕ → ℝ) (m : ℕ) (hn : ∀ i, i ≤ m → 0 ≤ g i) (A : ℝ)
    (H : ∀ i, i+2 ≤ m → g (i+1)^2 ≤ g i*g (i+2)) (h : g 0 ≤ A) (he : g m≤A) : ∀ i ≤ m, g i ≤ A := by
  -- strict increase propagates
  have hv i (hp : i+1 ≤ m) (hr : g i < g (i+1)) : g (i+1) ≤ A := by
    have he_idx (p : ℕ) (hr' : g p<g (p+1)) (hs : p+2≤m) : g (p+1)<g (p+2) := by
      have hl := H p hs
      have ha := hn p (by omega)
      have hh := hn (p+2) hs
      by_contra! hv
      apply (not_le.mpr ?_ hl)
      calc _ ≤ g p * g (p+1) := by gcongr
           _ < _ := by nlinarith
    have ht (q : ℕ) (hq : i≤q) (hz : q+1≤m) : g q<g (q+1) ∧ g (i+1) ≤ g (q+1) := by
      induction q, hq using Nat.le_induction with
      | base => exact ⟨hr,le_rfl⟩
      | succ n hn ih => exact ⟨he_idx _ (ih (by omega)).1 hz,(ih (by omega)).2.trans (he_idx _ (ih (by omega)).1 hz).le⟩
    have hs : g (i+1) ≤ g ((m-1)+1) := (ht _ (by omega) (by omega)).2
    rw [show m-1+1=m by omega] at hs; exact hs.trans he
  intro i hi; induction i with
  | zero => exact h
  | succ i ih => exact le_or_gt (g (i+1)) (g i) |>.elim (fun h => h.trans (ih (by omega))) (fun h => hv i hi h)

private lemma realPrice {A B C D E F J K : X → ℂ}
    (ha : Envelope A) (hb : Envelope B) (hc : Envelope C) (hd : Envelope D)
    (he : Envelope E) (hf : Envelope F) (hj : Envelope J) (hk : Envelope K)
    (hp : ∀ x, star ((A-B) x) = (A-B) x) {a b c d : ℝ}
    (h₁ : ‖bi μ A C - bi μ E J‖ ≤ a) (h₂ : ‖bi μ A D - bi μ E K‖ ≤ b)
    (h₃ : ‖bi μ B C - bi μ F J‖ ≤ c) (h₄ : ‖bi μ B D - bi μ F K‖ ≤ d) :
    |(∫ x, ((A-B) x).re * ((C-D) x).re ∂μ) - ∫ x, ((E x-F x)*(J x-K x)).re ∂μ| ≤ (a+b)+(c+d) := by
  have ht {A B C D : X → ℂ} (ha : Envelope A) (hb : Envelope B) (hc : Envelope C) (hd : Envelope D) :
      (∫ x, ((A x-B x)*(C x-D x)).re ∂μ) = (bi μ (A-B) (C-D)).re :=
    integral_re (((ha.subC hb).mulC (hc.subC hd)).integrableC μ)
  have hl (x) : ((A-B) x).re * ((C-D) x).re=((A x-B x)*(C x-D x)).re := by
    have hh : ↑((A-B) x).re=((A-B) x) := Complex.conj_eq_iff_re.mp (hp x)
    change _ = (((A-B) x)*((C-D) x)).re; conv_rhs => rw [← hh]
    simp
  simp_rw [hl]; rw [ht ha hb hc hd,ht he hf hj hk, ← Complex.sub_re]
  apply (Complex.abs_re_le_norm _).trans
  rw [swapped μ A B C D ha hb hc hd,swapped μ E F J K he hf hj hk]
  rw [show (bi μ A C- _ - (bi μ B C- _)) - (bi μ E J-bi μ E K-(bi μ F J-bi μ F K))=
      (bi μ A C-bi μ E J)-(bi μ A D-bi μ E K) - ((bi μ B C-bi μ F J)-(bi μ B D-bi μ F K)) by abel]
  exact (norm_sub_le ..).trans (add_le_add ((norm_sub_le ..).trans (add_le_add h₁ h₂))
    ((norm_sub_le ..).trans (add_le_add h₃ h₄)))

def PositionsUV (C : Family G) (e : Extraction.Sequence) :=
  ∀ (p n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → C.book.Token),
   ∃ f : Points n → ℂ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (NoHit C.S p n) ∧
     (∀ t : Test n, suitable C.S p t → Tendsto (fun j => Order.smears C (e j) p v t) atTop (𝓝 (t.applyTo f))) ∧
     ∀ l : List (Reach n),
       let F N := squall (C.S.a N) l (lifted C N p v)
       let g := derive f (l.map Reach.where_)
       Cluster C e p n F g ∧
       Meets (NoHit C.S p n) (fun j => interpolated C.S (e j) (F (e j))) g ∧
       ∀ t : Test n, suitable C.S p t →
         Integrable (fun x : Points n => t x * g x) ∧
         Tendsto (fun j => sumOn F C.S p (e j) t) atTop (𝓝 (t.applyTo g))

lemma volume_oscillates (H : TransferLip C f) (n : ℕ) {P} (Hp : f.Meshes C P) (v : Fin n → C.book.Token) :
    oscillation (generic n) (fun i x => (P (f.per i)).read x v) := by
  intro K hU hk ε hε
  obtain ⟨T,hT,hKT,hTg⟩ := exists_compact_between hk (genericOpen n) hU
  obtain ⟨d,hd,H⟩ := H.expanding n _ hT hTg v (ε/2) (by positivity)
  refine ⟨d,hd,?_⟩
  unfold Order.late at H
  filter_upwards [H, f.per.cofinal.eventually (room C.S hT)] with i hi hr x hx y hy hD
  let p := f.per i
  have he (x : Points n) (hx : x ∈ K) : x ∈ Cyclic C.S p n :=
    (no_wrap_tie C.S (hr (interior_subset (hKT hx)))).mpr (hU hx)
  let a (j : ℕ) := C.S.a (f.mesh j)
  let r (x : Points n) (j : ℕ) := address (a j) x
  let w j := tag (a j) (n := n)
  have hu (x) : Tendsto (fun i => w i (r x i)) atTop (𝓝 x) := (chosen (S := C.S) x).comp f.mesh.cofinal
  have hh (x hx) := f.evaluated C Hp p n v x (he x hx) (r x) (hu x)
  have ht : dist ((P (f.per i)).read x v) ((P (f.per i)).read y v) ≤ ε/2 := by
    apply le_of_tendsto ((hh x hx).dist (hh y hy))
    have hp := ((hu x).dist (hu y)).eventually (gt_mem_nhds hD)
    filter_upwards [hi, hp,(hu x).eventually (mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds.mp (hKT hx)),
      (hu y).eventually (mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds.mp (hKT hy))] with j ht hu hv hw
    exact (ht (r x j) (r y j) hv hw hu).le
  linarith
ends.conclusion: From `TransferLip.expanding`, the limit tables `(P (f.per i)).read x v` are equicontinuous (`oscillation`) on compacts of `generic n`, via `Order.evaluated` at each fixed p.

theorem first_surface (H : TransferLip C f) (h : Bound C f) :
    ∃ g : Order, ∃ S P, RawLimits C (f.refine g) S P := by
  obtain ⟨t,P,hP⟩ := setMeshes C f H h
  let w := f.refine (meshMore t)
  let F (p : Indices C.book) (j) (x) := (P (w.per j)).read x (stack p)
  obtain ⟨u,v,hu⟩ := localAscoli (fun i : Indices C.book => Points i.1) (fun i => generic i.1) (fun i => genericOpen _)
    F (fun p => volume_oscillates _ _ (further _ _ H _) p.1 hP (stack p))
    (fun p x hx => extendsBound _ _ (h.further _) hP _ hx)
  let g := Order.mk t u
  let S := fitted v
  have Hs (n) (p : Fin n → C.book.Token) : Meets (generic n)
      (fun i x => (P ((f.refine g).per i)).read x p) (fun x => S.read x p) := by
    apply components S (fun i => P _) generic _ n p
    intro i; simpa only [S,knobs] using! hu i
  have hm : (f.refine g).Meshes C P := ⟨hP.continuous,hP.onK⟩
  have hV : (f.refine g).VolumePoints C S P := by
    intro n K hk he v ε hε
    simpa only [dist_eq_norm] using (Hs n v).uniform K he hk ε hε
  exact ⟨g,S,P,⟨fun n p => (Hs n p).continuousOn,hm,hV, Order.poses _ _ (h.further g) ⟨P,hm,hV⟩⟩⟩

  let B := Metric.closedBall (0 : Points v.n) (M+1)

  obtain ⟨T,hT,hf⟩ := Order.testSup v.f

    rw [Order.fused, Order.late]
    unfold Order.late at he
    filter_upwards [he,f.per.cofinal.eventually hp] with p he' hp'
    filter_upwards [he',f.mesh.cofinal.eventually hmesh] with N hg' ha x
    let n' := f.mesh N

    let r := bucket n' p' x (S := C.S)
    let t := tag (C.S.a n') (address (C.S.a n') x)

    have hpos : 0 ≤ B.indicator (fun _ => bound (n',p')) x := indicator_nonneg (fun _ _ => by
      dsimp only [bound]; positivity) _
    by_cases hx : x ∈ Fund C.S p' v.n
    · have hcell : Order.cells C n' p' r = t := cells_bucket C hx
      change ‖(Fund C.S p' v.n).indicator _ x‖ ≤ _
      rw [indicator_of_mem hx]
      change ‖v.f (Order.cells C n' p' r) * featuring P v.left v.i n' p' r‖ ≤ _
      rw [hcell]
      rcases eq_or_ne (v.f t) 0 with ht|ht
      · rwa [ht,zero_mul,norm_zero]
      have htK : t ∈ K := subset_closure ht
      have hd := approximate (C.S.a_pos n') x
      change dist t x ≤ _ at hd

      rw [indicator_of_mem hxB]

theorem compat (hs : S.Smooth) (h : S.Symmetric) (H : S.RealSpin) (P : DiffPlan S)
    (hd : P.Derivatives S) (hu : P.Inclusions S) : P.Orientation H where
  realInc e B := by
    apply real_ext h H; intro n q x hx
    rw [hu.kernels e _ hx, real_front h H B hx, hu.kernels e B hx]
  realDer d a B := by
    apply real_ext h H; intro n q x hx
    rw [hd.kernels _ _ _ hx, hd.kernels d a B hx, ← gradient_star]
    apply GermD
    filter_upwards [(conf_open _).mem_nhds hx] with y hy
    exact real_front h H B hy q
  mirrorInc e s B := by
    apply signed_ext h H s; intro n q x hx
    rw [hu.kernels e _ (move_in _ hx), signed_front h H B s hx, hu.kernels e B hx]
  mirrorDer d b s B := by
    apply signed_ext h H s; intro n q x hx
    let t := signedTag H s ∘ q
    let B' := S.mirror H d s B
    let u : Fin (n+1) → S.Tag := Fin.cons ⟨d,B'⟩ t
    let f z := S.useAt S z u
    let y := move s.ortho x
    have hy : y ∈ conf _ := move_in _ hx
    let m := Ward.here u y 0 (d+1)
    have em (p : S.Field (d+1)) : m p = S.useAt S y (Fin.cons ⟨d+1,p⟩ t) := by
      rw [show m p = _ from Ward.takes u y 0 (d+1) p, Fin.update_cons_zero]; rfl
    change S.useAt S y _ = _
    rw [← em, map_sum]
    have hf := (((S.class_smooth S hs u) y hy).contDiffAt ((conf_open _).mem_nhds hy)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    calc
      _ = ∑ a, s.ortho.val a b • gradient 0 a f y := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro a _
        rw [map_smul, em, hd.kernels d a B' hy,Complex.real_smul]; rfl
      _ = gradient 0 b (f ∘ move s.ortho) x := (gradient_move _ _ b f x hf).symm
      _ = gradient 0 b (fun z => S.useAt S z (Fin.cons ⟨d,B⟩ q)) x := by
        apply GermD
        filter_upwards [(conf_open _).mem_nhds hx] with z hz
        exact signed_front h H B s hz q
      _ = _ := (hd.kernels d b B hx q).symm
ends.conclusion: `Orientation`: inclusions and derivatives commute with conjugation and signed permutations, with `mirrorDer d b s B = sum_a s.ortho a b * deriv d a (mirror B)`.

theorem hosting (G : Gauge) (j : ℕ) : ∃ d, ∀ (k : ℕ) (p : WickPol G), p∈shelf G j → Pure k p → Painted p → p ∈ Host G d k := by
  classical
  let R := ↥(Rack G j)
  letI := finstock G j
  let V : Set R := {p|∃ k : ℕ,0< k ∧ Pure k p.val ∧ Painted p.val}
  let W : Submodule R R := Submodule.span R V
  obtain ⟨s,hs,h⟩ := (Submodule.fg_span_iff_fg_span_finset_subset (R:=R) V).mp (show W.FG from IsNoetherian.noetherian _)
  choose L hL using (fun p : R => cap_exists p.val)
  let d := s.sup L
  refine ⟨d,?_⟩
  intro k
  induction k using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h k ih =>
    intro p hp hK H
    by_cases ht : k=0
    · subst k; rw [bulk_zero p hK]
      have h : (1:WickPol G)∈ Host G d 0 := by
        apply Submodule.subset_span; exact ⟨0,fun _ => 0,fun _ => 1, isEmptyElim,by simp,by simp⟩
      nth_rw 1 [← mul_one (C _)]; rw [C_mul']; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ h
    let u : R := ⟨p,hp⟩
    let A : WickPol G →ₗ[ℂ] WickPol G := moyenne G |>.comp (distill k)
    have he (b : R) (hh : b∈ Submodule.span R (s:Set R)) (r : R) : A (r.val*b.val) ∈ Host G d k := by
      induction hh using Submodule.span_induction generalizing r with
      | mem b hh =>
        obtain ⟨l,ht,h',H⟩ := hs hh
        have hd : b.val∈shellSector G d := chain (Finset.le_sup (f:=L) hh) (sector.mpr ⟨hL b,H⟩)
        change moyenne G (distill k (_ * _)) ∈ _
        rw [distills_mul _ _ k l h']; split_ifs with hw
        · rw [paints_fact H]
          have hi : k-l < k := by omega
          have hy := gloss_shelf (fun i => (1:ℕ)) (k-l) r.val r.property
          let B := moyenne G (distill (k-l) r.val)
          have ha : k-l+l=k := by omega
          have hk : Pure (k-l) B := by
            rw [show B= distill (k-l) (moyenne G r.val) from (moyenne_gloss (fun _ => (1:ℕ)) _ _).symm]
            exact weightedHomogeneousComponent_isWeightedHomogeneous (k-l) _
          have hm := host_extend hd h' (ih (k-l) hi B (spaced_moy _ hy) hk (painted_moy _))
          rw [ha] at hm; exact hm
        rw [map_zero]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
      | zero => simp [R]
      | add p q _ _ hx hy =>
        change A (r.val*(p.val+q.val))∈_; rw [mul_add,map_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ (hx r) (hy r)
      | smul c p _ hv => change A (r.val*(c.val*p.val)) ∈ _; rw [← mul_assoc]; exact hv (r*c)
    have ht := he u (h ▸ Submodule.subset_span (show u∈V from ⟨k,Nat.pos_of_ne_zero ht,hK,H⟩)) 1
    change moyenne G (distill k (1*p)) ∈ _ at ht; rwa [one_mul,(distilled_eq k p).mp hK,paints_self H] at ht
ends.conclusion: By Noetherianity of `Rack G j` (`finstock`), finitely many pure painted generators, gauge averaging `moyenne` and induction on degree, every invariant pure polynomial lies in `Host G d k`, products of factors of weight at most `d`.

    let s := Signed.reflect timeAxis
    let K := mirrorBar s P

      rw [show s*s=1 by unfold s; nth_rw 1 [← mirrored_inv timeAxis]; exact inv_mul_cancel _,pol_one]
      apply equalPol; intro A; rw [real_eval,real_eval,star_star]
    have hk : K≠0 := fun H => hv (he.symm.trans (by rw [H,map_zero]))

    change 0 < moment G (Table.Pairing.closedUp timeAxis v v) (Fin.append (mirrorBar s ∘ (fun _ : Fin 1 => K)) (fun _ => K)) at ht

lemma clears_faint {f : E4 → F} (H : Pole r f) (hr : 2 ≤ r) (S : Clears (r-2) f) : EqOn f 0 away := by
  have he {s : ℕ} (B : Clears s f) (h : s < r-1) : Clears 0 f := by
    induction s with
    | zero => exact B
    | succ s ih =>
      apply ih _ (by omega)
      obtain ⟨g,hg,hv⟩ := B
      let w := (4*(s+1:ℕ)*((s:ℝ)+2 - (r:ℝ)):ℝ)
      have hw : w≠0 := by
        have ht : s+2 < r := by omega
        apply mul_ne_zero (by positivity); apply sub_ne_zero.mpr
        exact (by exact_mod_cast Nat.ne_of_lt ht : (s:ℝ)+2≠r)
      refine ⟨w⁻¹ • lap g,(contDiff_iff_contDiffAt.mpr fun y => lap_smooth hg.contDiffAt).const_smul _,fun x hx => ?_⟩
      have he : g =ᶠ[𝓝 x] rad (s+1) • f := (show EqOn g _ away from fun y h => (hv y h).symm).eventuallyEq_of_mem (open_away.mem_nhds hx)
      rw [Pi.smul_apply, lap_local he, lap_valued H s hx]; exact (inv_smul_smul₀ hw _).symm
  obtain ⟨g,hg,hv⟩ := he S (by omega)
  intro x hx
  let y (t : ℝ) := t • x
  have ht : Tendsto id little (𝓝 (0:ℝ)) := tendsto_id.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
  have hm := (ht.pow r).smul ((hg.continuous.continuousAt (x:=(0:ℝ) • x)).tendsto.comp (ht.smul tendsto_const_nhds))
  rw [zero_pow (n:=r) (by omega),zero_smul] at hm
  have hv : Tendsto (fun _ : ℝ => f x) little (𝓝 0) := by
    apply hm.congr'
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin (a:=(0:ℝ)) (s:=Ioi 0)] with t hl
    change t^r • g (y t)=f x
    have h : 0 < t := hl
    rw [← hv _ (show y t∈away from smul_ne_zero h.ne' hx),show rad 0 _=1 from pow_zero _,one_smul]
    unfold y; rw [H.degree _ h _ hx,inv_pow,smul_inv_smul₀ (by positivity : t^r≠0)]
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique tendsto_const_nhds hv

  have he (c : G.ColorIndex) : ∃ (q : Flavor c.val) (v : Sheet c.val), q v = 1 := by
    let B := Module.finBasis ℝ (Sheet c.val)
    letI := has_sheet h c.val
    let i := (⟨0,Module.finrank_pos⟩ : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ (Sheet c.val)))
    exact ⟨B.coord i, B i, (Module.Basis.repr_self_apply B i i).trans (if_pos rfl)⟩
  choose q w hw using he
  let A := Matrix.of fun c i : G.ColorIndex => bit (q c) i
  refine ⟨q,fun H => ?_⟩
  let y : TaylorTower G := fun j => if h:j<G.lieDim then fill j (unitColor G ⟨j,h⟩) (w ⟨j,h⟩) else 0

    rw [show y a.val=fill _ (unitColor G a) (w a) from dif_pos a.isLt, Matrix.one_apply]
    by_cases h:a=b
    · subst b; rw [tasted,hw,if_pos rfl]; rfl

    rw [which,unitPaint a b,if_neg (Ne.symm h),zero_smul,map_zero]; rfl
  have hk : P A.det=1 := by rw [AlgHom.map_det,show P.mapMatrix A=1 from hh, Matrix.det_one]

lemma ranging (p : Flavor j) (l : ℕ) (H : ∀ (z:E4), z≠0 → ∀ q : Flavor l, fare c p q z=0) : p=0 := by
  induction l with
  | zero => exact payment c H
  | succ l ih =>
    apply ih
    intro x hx q
    let P := flavor j c p
    let Q := flavor l c q
    have he := K_right_D P Q (x := x) (y := 0) hx x
    have hp := kernel_pole P Q
    have hw := pole_power hp hx
    rw [← consecutive x q c, K,sub_zero,show legKernel _ _ x=0 from H _ hx _] at he
    let L := fun y : E4 => x-y
    have hf : HasFDerivAt L (-(ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E4)) 0 := by
      convert! ((hasFDerivAt_id (0:E4) (𝕜:=ℝ)).const_sub x) using 1
    have hl : L 0=x := sub_zero _
    have hh : DifferentiableAt ℝ (legKernel P Q) (L 0) := by rw [hl]; exact (kernel_smooth P Q hx).differentiableAt (by simp)
    change fderiv ℝ (legKernel P Q ∘ L) 0 x=0 at he
    rw [fderiv_comp _ hh hf.differentiableAt,hf.fderiv,hl,ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply] at he
    change fderiv ℝ (legKernel P Q) x (-x)=0 at he; rw [map_neg,neg_eq_zero] at he; change D x _ x=_ at he; rw [hw] at he
    exact (smul_eq_zero.mp he).resolve_left (neg_ne_zero.mpr (by positivity))

lemma scenes_gone (t : Vector d (Model F)) : (∀ s : Scene (Model F) d, s.lens t=0) ↔ quiet F t := by
  constructor
  · intro v n a p x hx
    obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := exists_ne a
    obtain ⟨y,hy,hA,h⟩ := to_scanner hx b
    let f := diagram p (t a)
    have hh (m) (B : Fin m → Points n) : iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f y B=0 := v ⟨n,p,b,a,hb.symm,y,hy,hA,m,B⟩
    have hg : f =ᶠ[𝓝 y] 0 := by
      obtain ⟨P,r,hP⟩ := lenses F p _ y hy
      have hw : Tendsto (fun z : Points n => z-y) (𝓝 y) (𝓝 0) := by
        simpa only [id_eq,sub_self] using (tendsto_id (x:=𝓝 y)).sub (tendsto_const_nhds (x:=y))
      filter_upwards [hw.eventually (Metric.eball_mem_nhds _ hP.r_pos)] with z hz
      change z-y ∈ Metric.eball _ _ at hz
      have hl := hP.hasSum_iteratedFDeriv hz
      change HasSum (fun i => ((↑(i.factorial):ℝ)⁻¹) • iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f y fun _=> z - y) _ at hl
      simp_rw [hh,smul_zero,add_sub_cancel] at hl

    exact ((lenses F p _).mono h).eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq_zero (convex_segment .. |>.isPreconnected) (left_mem_segment ..) hg (right_mem_segment ..)
  intro H s

private lemma to_scanner {x : Points n} (hx : x∈conf _) (a : Axis) : ∃ y∈conf n,onLine a y ∧ segment ℝ y x ⊆ conf _ := by
  obtain ⟨p,hp,hA⟩ := tiesAway (fun i => x i a)
  let y := points fun i => p i • basis a
  have he : y∈conf n := fun i j h => hp (smul_left_injective ℝ (show basis a≠0 from norm_ne_zero_iff.mp (by simp)) h)
  refine ⟨y,he,fun i => ⟨p i,rfl⟩,?_⟩
  rintro z ⟨u,t,hu,hW,h,rfl⟩
  by_cases ho : u=0
  · rw [ho,zero_add] at h; rw [ho,h,zero_smul,one_smul,zero_add]; exact hx
  by_cases hv : t=0
  · rw [hv,add_zero] at h; rw [hv,h,zero_smul,one_smul,add_zero]; exact he
  have hh (i : Fin n) : (u • y+t • x) i a = u*p i+t*x i a := by simp [y]
  intro i j hi
  have ht : (u • y+t • x) i a=(u • y+t • x) j a := congr_arg (fun x : E4 => x a) hi
  rw [hh,hh] at ht
  rcases lt_trichotomy (x i a) (x j a) with H|H|H
  · have h := hA i j H
    exact ((add_lt_add_of_lt_of_le (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h (lt_of_le_of_ne hu (Ne.symm ho))) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left H.le hW)).ne ht).elim
  · rw [H] at ht; exact hp (mul_left_cancel₀ ho (add_right_cancel ht))
  have h := hA j i H
  exact ((add_lt_add_of_lt_of_le (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h (lt_of_le_of_ne hu (Ne.symm ho))) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left H.le hW)).ne ht.symm).elim

    · apply le_iInf; intro s

theorem none {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module ℝ M]
    (T : Ortho.Skew →ₗ[ℝ] Ortho.Skew →ₗ[ℝ] M) (h : ∀ u,T u u=0) (hp : ∀ a b (u v : Ortho.Skew), a≠b →
      T (orients (quarter a b) u) (orients (quarter a b) v)=T u v) : T=0 := by
  have halt (u v) : T v u= - T u v := by
    have he := h (u+v); simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, h, add_zero,zero_add] at he
    exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left he
  have hz {x : M} (hx : x= -x) : x=0 := by
    apply (smul_right_injective M (by norm_num : (2:ℝ)≠0));
    change (2:ℝ) • x = (2:ℝ) • 0; rw [two_smul,smul_zero]; nth_rw 1 [hx]; simp
  have ht (a b c : Axis) (ha : a≠b) (hb : a≠c) : T (Ortho.plane a b) (Ortho.plane a c)=0 := by
    by_cases hk : b=c
    · subst c; exact h _
    obtain ⟨d, hd, hv, hi⟩ : ∃ d : Axis,d≠a ∧ d≠b ∧ d≠c := by
      exact (show ∀ i j k : Fin 4, ∃ l : Fin 4, l≠i ∧ l≠j ∧ l≠k from by decide) a b c
    let s := quarter c d * quarter c d
    have hs (i j) : orients s (Ortho.plane i j) = _ := bracket_orient s i j
    apply hz
    conv_lhs => rw [← show T (orients s (Ortho.plane a b)) (orients s (Ortho.plane a c)) = _ from commute_inv_apply T hp c d hi.symm a b a c]
    simp only [hs]
    simp [s, quarter,Equiv.swap_apply_def,hb,hd,hv,hi,hk,Ne.symm]
  have hd (a b i l : Axis) (hab : a ≠ b) (hai : a≠i) (hal : a≠l) (hbi : b≠i) (hbl : b≠l) (hil : i≠l) :
      T (Ortho.plane a b) (Ortho.plane i l)=0 := by
    apply hz
    conv_lhs => rw [← hp a i _ _ hai]
    have heta : orients (quarter a i) (Ortho.plane a b)= -Ortho.plane i b := by rw [bracket_orient]; simp [quarter,Equiv.swap_apply_def,hab,hbi,Ne.symm]; exact neg_one_smul ℝ (Ortho.plane i b)
    have heib : orients (quarter a i) (Ortho.plane i l)= Ortho.plane a l := by rw [bracket_orient]; simp [quarter,Equiv.swap_apply_def,hai,hal,hil,Ne.symm]
    rw [heta,heib,map_neg,LinearMap.neg_apply]; congr 1
    conv_lhs => rw [← hp b l _ _ hbl]
    have Hta : orients (quarter b l) (Ortho.plane i b)= -Ortho.plane i l := by rw [bracket_orient]; simp [quarter,Equiv.swap_apply_def,hbi,hil,Ne.symm]; exact neg_one_smul ℝ (Ortho.plane i l)
    have Htz : orients (quarter b l) (Ortho.plane a l)= Ortho.plane a b := by rw [bracket_orient]; simp [quarter,Equiv.swap_apply_def,hab,hal,hbl,Ne.symm]
    rw [Hta,Htz,map_neg,LinearMap.neg_apply,halt (Ortho.plane a b), neg_neg]
  have hh (a b : Axis) : Ortho.plane b a = -Ortho.plane a b := Subtype.ext (neg_sub _ _).symm
  have hk (a b i l : Axis) : T (Ortho.plane a b) (Ortho.plane i l)=0 := by
    have hu (a) : Ortho.plane a a=0 := Subtype.ext (sub_self _)
    rcases eq_or_ne a b with he|he
    · subst b; simp [hu]
    rcases eq_or_ne i l with h1|h1
    · subst l; simp [hu]
    by_cases h' : a=i
    · subst i; exact ht a b l he h1
    by_cases h'' : a=l
    · subst l; rw [hh a i]; simp only [map_neg,ht a b i he h1.symm,neg_zero]
    by_cases hb : b=i
    · subst i; rw [hh b a]; simp only [map_neg,LinearMap.neg_apply,ht b a l he.symm h1, neg_zero]
    by_cases hl : b=l
    · subst l; rw [hh b a,hh b i]; simp only [map_neg,LinearMap.neg_apply,ht b a i he.symm h1.symm,neg_zero]
    exact hd a b i l he h' h'' hb hl h1
  apply LinearMap.ext_on Spin.spans; rintro x ⟨p,rfl⟩; apply LinearMap.ext_on Spin.spans; rintro y ⟨q,rfl⟩; exact hk ..
ends.conclusion: An alternating bilinear map on skew matrices invariant under all quarter-turn orientations is zero (overlapping planes and disjoint planes handled separately).

lemma complete_turn {T : Module.End ℂ ((Model F).Field d)}
    (h : ∀ u p,(gear F).lie d u (T p)=T ((gear F).lie d u p))

    rw [h]; exact L.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt s (circle_ode F u p s)
  rw [Corners.sendsTime i j he]

theorem commute_ghost {L : Engine G 0} {T : Module.End ℂ (WickPol G)} (hd : 4≤d) (H : silence G d T)
    (ht : ∀ a b, T (polStress G a b)=0)
    (HL : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : Points (n+1)), x∈conf _ → ∃ χ v, Table.Window x χ ∧ Motion (x:=x 0) v L χ)
    (p : WickPol G) (hp : p∈shellSector G d) (he : rewired L p∈shellSector G d) :
    rewired L (T p) - T (rewired L p) ∈ ghost G d := by

  classical
  obtain ⟨χ,v,w,Hv⟩ := HL n x hx
  let B (p : WickPol G) := Fin.cons (α:=fun _ : Fin (n+1) => WickPol G) p q
  let f (i : Fin (n+1)) := update (B p) i (T (B p i))
  let R (i) := stressRead x v (f i)
  have hh : exportFlux (fun a y => ∑ i, R i a y) χ=0 := by
    rw [flux_invariant χ _ 0]
    · simp [exportFlux]
    intro a y hy
    have hu := Work.A01.window_separated hx w hy
    unfold R stressRead; rw [Finset.sum_comm];
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun b _ => ?_
    rw [← Finset.smul_sum];
    suffices hr : (∑ i, bookend x y (f i) (polStress G a b))=0 by rw [hr, smul_zero]
    have hm (i : Fin (n+1)) : B p i ∈ shellSector G d := Fin.cases hp hq i
    have ha := H _ (Fin.cons (α:=fun _ => WickPol G) (polStress G a b) (B p)) (Points.cons y x)
      (fun i => Fin.cases (chain hd (stress_label G a b)) hm i) hu
    conv at ha => lhs; rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ]
    simp only [Fin.cons_zero, ht] at ha
    rw [show moment G (Points.cons y x) (update (Fin.cons (α:=fun _ => WickPol G) (polStress G a b) (B p)) 0 0)=0 from
      MultilinearMap.map_coord_zero _ 0 (Function.update_self _ _ _),zero_add] at ha; refine Eq.trans ?_ ha
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro i _
    rw [book_eval,Fin.cons_succ]; congr 1
    exact Fin.cons_update ..
  rw [flux_series w.1 w.2.1] at hh
  · simp_rw [R,moment_force hx w Hv,Finset.sum_neg_distrib,neg_eq_zero] at hh
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ] at hh
    have ha := H (n+1) (B (rewired L p)) x (fun i => Fin.cases he hq i) hx
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ] at ha

    let F := ((moment G x).toLinearMap (B p) 0)
    have hg v : moment G x (B v) = F v := by unfold F; rw [MultilinearMap.toLinearMap_apply]; unfold B; rw [Fin.update_cons_zero]

theorem answer : YM.Bid.A02 := by
  intro G L S h W hd _ J p Y hw
  -- Test the field identities first with all exterior words. No need here to
  -- use inclusion properties to change caps.
  constructor
  · intro d b v u
    apply S.field_ext h.laws.toSymmetric
    intro n q x hx
    obtain ⟨χ, hχ⟩ := exists_window hx
    have hh : (fun t => shellSpin S J χ v (Ward.cast x 0 b t) q u) =ᶠ[𝓝 0]
        fun t => S.useAt S (Ward.cast x 0 b t) (Fin.cons ⟨d, Y d v u⟩ q) := by
      filter_upwards [stable hx hχ b] with t ht
      exact hw.raw.rotation ht.1 q ht.2 v d u
    have he := (deriv_head h hd hx b (Y d v u) q).unique
      (hh.hasDerivAt_iff.mp (deriv_shellSpin h hd hx hχ b J v u q))
    let T : Fin (n+1) → S.Tag := Fin.cons ⟨d, u⟩ q
    have hf (w : S.Field (d+1)) : S.useAt S x (Fin.cons ⟨d+1, w⟩ q) =
        Ward.here T x 0 (d+1) w := by
      rw [Ward.takes, show T = Fin.cons _ q from rfl, Fin.update_cons_zero]
      rfl
    rw [hf, map_add, map_sum]
    simp_rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, ← hf]
    rw [he, hw.raw.rotation hx q hχ v (d+1)]
    simp_rw [hw.raw.translation hx q hχ]
    rw [sub_add_cancel]
  · intro d b i u
    apply S.field_ext h.laws.toSymmetric
    intro n q x hx
    obtain ⟨χ, hχ⟩ := exists_window hx
    have hh : (fun t => shellGrad S J χ i (Ward.cast x 0 b t) q u) =ᶠ[𝓝 0]
        fun t => S.useAt S (Ward.cast x 0 b t) (Fin.cons ⟨d+1, p d i u⟩ q) := by
      filter_upwards [stable hx hχ b] with t ht
      exact hw.raw.translation ht.1 q ht.2 i d u
    have he := (deriv_head h hd hx b (p d i u) q).unique
      (hh.hasDerivAt_iff.mp (deriv_shellGrad h hd hx hχ b i J u q))
    exact he.trans (hw.raw.translation hx q hχ i (d+1) (W.deriv d b u))

lemma deriv_shellSpin {x : Points (n+1)} (hx : x ∈ conf _) (hw : Window x χ) (b : Axis)
    (J : S.Stress) (v : Ortho.Skew) {d : ℕ} (B : S.Field d) (q : Fin n → S.Tag) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => shellSpin S J χ v (Ward.cast x 0 b t) q B)
      (shellSpin S J χ v x q (W.deriv d b B) -
        ∑ c : Axis, (v.val c b : ℂ) * shellGrad S J χ c x q B) 0 := by
  let F (a c : Axis) (t : ℝ) := ∫ y : E4,
    ((Analysis.D (basis a) χ y * M4.move v.val (y - Ward.cast x 0 b t 0) c : ℝ) : ℂ) *
      S.useAt S (Points.cons y (Ward.cast x 0 b t)) (Fin.cons ⟨4, J a c⟩ (Fin.cons ⟨d, B⟩ q))
  let A (a c : Axis) := ∫ y : E4,
    ((Analysis.D (basis a) χ y * M4.move v.val (y - x 0) c : ℝ) : ℂ) *
      S.useAt S (Points.cons y x) (Fin.cons ⟨4, J a c⟩ (Fin.cons ⟨d+1, W.deriv d b B⟩ q))
  let L' (a c : Axis) := ∫ y : E4,
    ((Analysis.D (basis a) χ y : ℝ) : ℂ) *
      S.useAt S (Points.cons y x) (Fin.cons ⟨4, J a c⟩ (Fin.cons ⟨d, B⟩ q))
  have row (a c : Axis) : HasDerivAt (F a c) ((-(v.val c b : ℂ)) * L' a c + A a c) 0 := by
    let m (z : ℝ × E4) : ℂ := ↑(M4.move v.val (z.2 - Ward.cast x 0 b z.1 0) c)
    have cm : Continuous m := by
      unfold m
      simp_rw [center_eq]
      have ht : Continuous (Ward.cast x 0 b) := continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr
        (fun t => (Ward.moves x 0 b t).continuousAt)
      have hc : Continuous (fun y : E4 => M4.move v.val y c) := by
        simp_rw [M4.at_coord]; fun_prop
      exact Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp
        ((hc.comp continuous_snd).sub ((Ward.factor 0 c v).continuous.comp (ht.comp continuous_fst)))
    have hd' : ∀ (t : ℝ) (y : E4), HasDerivAt (fun s => m (s, y)) (-(v.val c b : ℂ)) t := by
      intro t y
      simpa only [m, Complex.ofReal_neg] using (deriv_center x v c b y t).ofReal_comp
    have he := deriv_integral h hd hx hw a b ⟨4, J a c⟩ d B q m (fun _ => -(v.val c b : ℂ))
      cm continuous_const hd'
    simp only [F, L', A, Complex.ofReal_mul]
    simp only [m, Ward.start] at he
    apply he.congr_deriv
    congr 1
    rw [← integral_const_mul]
    apply integral_congr_ae; filter_upwards with y; ring
  have he := HasDerivAt.fun_sum (u := (Finset.univ : Finset Axis))
    (fun a _ => HasDerivAt.fun_sum (u := (Finset.univ : Finset Axis)) (fun c _ => row a c))
  -- Both shells carry the leading minus sign. Regroup the terms from
  -- differentiating the centering as minus the matrix entries times the translation shells.
  apply (he.neg).congr_deriv
  change -(∑ a : Axis, ∑ c : Axis, (-(v.val c b : ℂ) * L' a c + A a c)) =
    -(∑ a : Axis, ∑ c : Axis, A a c) - ∑ c : Axis, (v.val c b : ℂ) * -(∑ a : Axis, L' a c)
  simp_rw [neg_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_neg_distrib, mul_neg, Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm (f := fun a c : Axis => (v.val c b : ℂ) * L' a c)]
  rw [Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
  abel
ends.conclusion: `deriv_shellSpin` differentiates the spin shell integral `shellSpin` along the motion of the first point.

theorem angular_hyper (hr : W.Inclusions S) (hd : W.Derivatives S) (hp : Pre h W J p Y) :
    Bid.Hyper h.spin W Y := by
  constructor
  · intro d u v
    apply ext_against_real h.laws.toSymmetric h.spin
    intro n q x hx
    obtain ⟨χ,hχ⟩ := exists_window x hx
    have ht := real_eval h.laws.toSymmetric h.spin hx (Fin.cons ⟨_,Y d u v⟩ q)
    rw [comp_cons, show realTag h.spin ⟨_,Y d u v⟩=⟨_,S.conj h.spin d (Y d u v)⟩ from rfl] at ht
    rw [ht, ← hp.raw.rotation hx q hχ u, ← hp.raw.rotation hx _ hχ u,
      ← flux_spin, ← flux_spin, flux_real h.laws.toSymmetric h.spin J hp.tensor.real hx hχ]
  · intro d e w u v
    apply S.field_ext h.laws.toSymmetric
    intro n q x hx
    obtain ⟨χ, hχ⟩ := exists_window x hx
    rw [hr.kernels w _ hx, ← hp.raw.rotation hx q hχ u e, ← hp.raw.rotation hx q hχ u d,
      ← flux_spin, ← flux_spin, flux_inclusion h.laws.toSymmetric hx W hr J hχ]
  · intro d u
    apply S.field_ext h.laws.toSymmetric
    intro n q x hx
    obtain ⟨χ, hχ⟩ := exists_window x hx
    rw [← front_eval q x _ 0, map_zero, ← hp.raw.rotation hx q hχ u, ← flux_spin]
    exact flux_unit h.laws h.smooth W hd J hp.tensor (orbital u (x 0)) (smooth_orbital _ _)
      (killing_orbital _ _) hx q χ hχ d
  · intro d k u v
    apply ext_against_mirror h.laws.toSymmetric h.spin k
    intro n q x hx
    obtain ⟨χ, hχ⟩ := exists_window x hx
    have hb := mirror_eval h.laws.toSymmetric h.spin hx (Fin.cons ⟨_,Y d u v⟩ q) k
    rw [comp_cons, show mirrorTag h.spin k ⟨_,Y d u v⟩=⟨_,S.mirror h.spin d k (Y d u v)⟩ from rfl] at hb
    rw [hb, ← hp.raw.rotation hx q hχ u d,
      ← hp.raw.rotation (Points.move_in _ hx) _ (window_move _ hχ) (Org.orients k u),
      ← flux_spin, ← flux_spin]
    exact (flux_mirror h.laws.toSymmetric h.spin J hp.symmetric k hx hχ
      (orbital u (x 0)) (orbital (Org.orients k u) (Ortho.move k.ortho (x 0))) (move_rotation k u (x 0)) q v).symm

lemma stagger (x : Points m) (hx : x∈conf _) (p : Parts S) (Y : SpinRows S) (q : Fin m→ S.Tag) (H : S.Hierarchy) (a b : Axis) (h : a≠b) :

private lemma full_jet (h : S.Hierarchy) (W : DiffPlan S)
    (inc : W.Inclusions S) (der : W.Derivatives S)
    (p : Parts S) (c : ColorLaw p W h.spin)
    (delta : ∀ d b i u, W.deriv (d+1) b (p d i u) = p (d+1) i (W.deriv d b u))
    (hl : LineSum p)
    (b j : Axis) (hj : j ≠ b)
    {x : Points n} (hx : x ∈ conf _) (ht : onLine b x)
    (q : Fin n → S.Tag) (m : ℕ) (u : Fin m → Points n) :
    iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (row p j q) x u = 0 := by
  induction m generalizing q with
  | zero =>
    simpa using all_line h W inc p c hl b j hj q hx ht
  | succ m ih =>
    have hr : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (row p j q) x := by
      apply ContDiffAt.sum
      exact fun i _ => cont_disc h _ hx
    have hh : ContDiffAt ℝ (↑(m+1 : ℕ)) (row p j q) x :=
      hr.of_le (show ((↑(m+1 : ℕ)) : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ from WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top)
    let v := Fin.init u
    let g : Points n →L[ℝ] ℂ := (iteratedFDeriv ℝ (m+1) (row p j q) x).curryRight v
    have hb (k : Fin n) (a : Axis) : g (Points.direction k a) = 0 := by
      change iteratedFDeriv ℝ (m+1) (row p j q) x (Fin.snoc v (Points.direction k a)) = 0
      have hp :
          D (Points.direction k a) (row p j q) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] row p j (update q k (rise W a (q k))) := by
        filter_upwards [(conf_open _).mem_nhds hx] with y hy
        exact row_D h W der p delta j q hy k a
      rw [snoc_jet hh, (hp.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds]
      exact ih _ _
    have ha (w : Points n) : g w = 0 := by
      rw [← expand_pts w, map_sum]
      simp [map_sum,hb]
    have hy := ha (u (Fin.last m))
    change iteratedFDeriv ℝ (m+1) (row p j q) x
      (Fin.snoc (Fin.init u) (u (Fin.last m))) = 0 at hy
    rwa [Fin.snoc_init_self] at hy
ends.conclusion: `full_jet` shows by induction on `m`, using `delta`, that every positional jet of the line sum vanishes on the line.

private lemma line_native (h : S.Hierarchy) (W : DiffPlan S) (der : W.Derivatives S) :
    LineSum W.deriv := by
  intro d n b j hj v x hx ht
  let q := column v
  let u := points fun _ : Fin n => basis j
  have hu : (∑ i : Fin n, Points.direction i j) = u := by
    simpa [u] using expand_pts u
  let F (t : ℝ) := x+t • u
  have hr : F 0 = x := by simp [F]
  have hh : HasDerivAt F u 0 := by
    have he := (ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℝ u).hasDerivAt (x := 0)
    simpa [F] using he.const_add x
  have he : (disc q ∘ F) = fun (_ : ℝ) => disc q x := by
    funext t
    exact h.translations n x hx (t • basis j) (fun i => ⟨(q i).1,S.representative _ (q i).2⟩)
  have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (disc q) (F 0) := by
    rw [hr]
    exact (cont_disc h q hx).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hz : fderiv ℝ (disc q) x u = 0 := by
    have hp := hd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt 0 hh
    rw [he,hr] at hp
    exact hp.unique (hasDerivAt_const _ _)
  change row W.deriv j q x = 0
  rw [← hz, ← hu, map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  exact (fromD W h der hx i j q).symm

theorem traverses (h : S.Hierarchy) (he : W.Derivatives S) (hc : commutes W T)
    {x : Points n} (hx : x∈conf _) (q : Fin n → S.Tag) (a : Axis) (k : Fin n) (K : Ortho.Skew) :
    let r := update q k (rise W a (q k))
    D (Points.direction k a) (angular W T q K) x= angular W T r K x := by
  intro r
  let t := Points.direction k a
  let comp (i) := disc (update q i (turns T K (q i)))
  let L (i) (b : Axis) := disc (update q i (rise W b (q i)))
  let y (i) (b) (z : Points n) := factor i b K z • L i b z
  let f (i) z := comp i z + ∑ b, y i b z
  have hu (i : Fin n) b : DifferentiableAt ℝ (L i b) x := (cont_disc h _ hx).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hh i b : DifferentiableAt ℝ (y i b) x := (factor i b K).differentiableAt.smul (hu i b)
  have hz i : DifferentiableAt ℝ (comp i) x := (cont_disc h _ hx).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hp i : DifferentiableAt ℝ (f i) x := (hz i).add (DifferentiableAt.fun_sum fun b hb => hh i b)
  have hm (i : Fin n) : D t (f i) x=D t (comp i) x+∑ b, D t (y i b) x := by
    simp only [f,D,fderiv_fun_add (hz i) (DifferentiableAt.fun_sum (fun b hb => hh i b)),
      fderiv_fun_sum (fun b hb => hh i b),_root_.sum_apply, _root_.add_apply]
  change fderiv ℝ (fun z => ∑ i, f i z) x t= _
  rw [fderiv_fun_sum (fun i hi => hp i),_root_.sum_apply]; unfold angular
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro i hi
  change D t (f i) x=_; rw [hm]
  by_cases hv : i=k
  · subst i; simp only [r,update_self,update_idem]
    -- derivative comm produces orbital cancel
    have hvb b : D t (y k b) x=(K.val b a) • disc (update q k (rise W b (q k))) x + factor k b K x • disc
        (update q k (rise W b (rise W a (q k)))) x := by
      unfold y
      rw [D_prod _ _ _ x (hu k b)]
      dsimp only [t,L]
      rw [fac,if_pos rfl,fromD W h he hx,update_self, update_idem]; unfold rise
      simp only
      rw [W.abelian h.laws.toSymmetric he h.smooth]
    simp_rw [hvb,Finset.sum_add_distrib,← add_assoc]
    congr 1
    unfold comp; rw [fromD W h he hx,update_self,update_idem]; unfold turns rise; simp only
    simp_rw [← takes,Complex.real_smul]
    rw [← hc _,map_add,map_sum]; simp
  have hu' : r i=q i := update_of_ne hv ..
  rw [hu']; congr 1
  · unfold comp; rw [fromD W h he hx,update_of_ne (Ne.symm hv),update_comm (show k≠i from (Ne.symm hv))] -- order check
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro b hb
  unfold y
  rw [D_prod _ _ _ x (hu i b)]
  dsimp only [L,t]; rw [fac,if_neg (Ne.symm hv),zero_smul,zero_add,fromD W h he hx,update_of_ne (Ne.symm hv),update_comm (show k≠i from (Ne.symm hv))]
  rfl
ends.conclusion: `traverses` shows every positional derivative of an angular sum is an angular sum with differentiated labels.

private lemma fills (x : Points n) : x∈closure {x : Points n | arranged a x} := by
  let v := points fun i : Fin n => (↑(i.val):ℝ) • basis a
  let z := fun t : ℝ => x+t • v
  have he : Tendsto z (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 x) := by
    have h : Continuous z := continuous_const.add (continuous_id.smul continuous_const)
    simpa [z] using (h.tendsto 0).mono_left (nhdsWithin_le_nhds (s := Ioi 0))
  have hu : ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[>] 0, ∀ i j, i≠j → z t i a≠ z t j a := by
    apply eventually_all.mpr; intro i; apply eventually_all.mpr; intro j
    by_cases h : i=j
    · exact Eventually.of_forall fun _ hx => (hx h).elim
    have hh : (i.val:ℝ)≠j.val := by exact_mod_cast (show i.val≠j.val from fun p => h (Fin.ext p))
    by_cases hi : x i a=x j a
    · filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with t ht Hh
      have hr : t≠0 := LT.lt.ne' ht
      simp [z,v,hi,hr]; exact fun hy => h (Fin.ext hy)
    have hp := he.eventually (show ({x : Points n | x i a ≠ x j a} : Set _) ∈ _ from
      (isOpen_ne_fun (by fun_prop : Continuous (fun x : Points n => x i a)) (by fun_prop)).mem_nhds hi)
    exact hp.mono fun x h _ => h
  apply mem_closure_of_tendsto he (hu.mono fun i hi => show arranged a (z i) from fun j k h => by_contra fun hg => hi j k hg h)

lemma pushes {x : Points n} {k : Fin n} (h : Earliest x a k) (w : b≠a) : ∃ y : Points n,
    Walk n x y ∧ (∀ i≠k, x i=y i) ∧ Latest y a k ∧ (∃ t : ℝ, y k=t • basis a) := by
  obtain ⟨T,hT⟩ := ta (fun i : Fin n => x i b)
  let u := cast x k b (T-x k b)
  have hi : Walk n x u := .bridge _ _ a _ _ (fun i s => Or.inl (still_first a b h w i))
  have hx : Latest u b k := by
    refine ⟨(still_first a b h w _).1,fun i h => ?_⟩
    simp [u,near _ _ _ h,hT i]
  obtain ⟨J,hJ⟩ := ta (fun i : Fin n => u i a)
  let v := cast u k a (J-u k a)
  have hv : Walk n u v := .bridge _ _ b a _ (fun i s => Or.inr (still_last b a hx w.symm i))
  have hz : Latest v a k := by
    refine ⟨(still_last b a hx w.symm _).1,fun i h => ?_⟩
    simp [v,near _ _ _ h,hJ i]
  obtain ⟨y,hy,he,hh,H,Hq⟩ := park1 a hz (Finset.univ.erase a) (by simp)
  refine ⟨y,(hi.transit hv).transit hy,fun i hi => (near x _ _ hi _ _).symm.trans
    ((near u _ _ hi _ _).symm.trans (hh i hi)), H,y k a, ?_⟩
  ext i; by_cases h : i=a; subst i; simp; simp [Hq i (by simp [h]),h]
ends.conclusion: `pushes` moves an `Earliest` point along `b` beyond all others (`Latest u b k`), then along `a` beyond all others (`Latest v a k`), then parks it on the axis.

lemma park1 {x : Points n} {k : Fin n} (h : Latest x a k) : ∀ s : Finset Axis,
    a∉s → ∃ y : Points n, Walk n x y ∧ y k a=x k a ∧ (∀ i≠k, x i=y i) ∧
      Latest y a k ∧ ∀ b∈s, y k b=0 := by
  intro s ht
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => exact ⟨x,.id x,rfl,fun _ _ => rfl,h,by simp⟩
  | @insert b s hb ih =>
    obtain ⟨y,hy,he,hs,h',hh⟩ := ih (fun e => ht (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem e))
    let v := -(y k b)
    let z := cast y k b v
    have hv : b≠a := by intro H; subst a; exact ht (by simp)
    refine ⟨z,Walk.transit hy (Walk.bridge y k a b v fun i _ => Or.inr (still_last a b h' hv i)), by simp [z, Ne.symm hv,he],
      fun i hi => (hs i hi).trans (near y _ _ hi _ _).symm, still_last a b h' hv v, ?_⟩
    intro i hi
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hi with hi|hi
    · subst i; simp [z,v]
    have hv' : i≠b := fun h => hb (h ▸ hi)
    simp [z,hv',hh i hi]

lemma casimir (p : Ind) : Commute (∑ q : Ind, f (Spin.K q)^2) (f (Spin.K p)) := by
  obtain ⟨i,j⟩ := p
  let P (a b : Axis) := f (plane a b)
  let g (a b : Axis) := (if b=i then P a j else 0) - (if b=j then P a i else 0) +
    (if a=i then P j b else 0) - (if a=j then P i b else 0)
  have hg (a b : Axis) : P a b * P i j - P i j * P a b = g a b := by
    dsimp [P]; rw [h, bracket_planes]; simp [P, g, apply_ite f]
  have he (a b : Axis) : P a b^2 * P i j - P i j * P a b^2 = P a b * g a b + g a b * P a b := by
    rw [← hg]; noncomm_ring
  change (∑ q : Ind, P q.1 q.2 ^ 2) * P i j = P i j * (∑ q : Ind, P q.1 q.2 ^ 2)
  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  dsimp only
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  simp_rw [Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, he]
  simp [g, mul_add, add_mul, mul_sub, sub_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  abel
ends.conclusion: `casimir` shows the sum of squares of the relative generators commutes with each one, the antisymmetric structure constants cancelling in pairs.

lemma rectify (A C ε : ℝ) (hC : ‖(1:R)‖ + ‖(2:R)‖*A < C) (x : R) (hx : ‖x‖ + C * (ε*2) ≤ A)
    (he : ‖defect x‖ ≤ ε) (hh : (‖(4:R)‖ * ε + ‖(3:R)‖) * ε ≤ 1/2) (hc : 0<C) :
    ∃ y : R, Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => φ^[n] x) atTop (𝓝 y) ∧ defect y=0 ∧ ‖y-x‖ ≤ C * (ε*2) := by
  let θ := (1:ℝ)/2
  have h : 0 ≤ ε := (norm_nonneg _).trans he
  let f (i : ℕ) := φ^[i] x
  have hθ : 0 < θ := by norm_num [θ]
  have ht i : f (i+1)=φ (f i) := iterate_succ_apply' ..
  let s (i : ℕ) := ε*θ^i
  have hs i : 0 ≤ s i := by unfold s; positivity
  have hb (i : ℕ) (hi : ‖defect (f i)‖ ≤ s i) (hy : ‖f i-x‖ ≤ C*(ε-s i)*2) :
      dist (f (i+1)) (f i) ≤ C * s i := by
    have hl : ‖f i‖ ≤ A := by
      calc ‖f i‖ ≤ ‖f i-x‖ + ‖x‖ := by nth_rw 1 [← sub_add_cancel (f i) x]; exact norm_add_le ..
           _ ≤ C*ε*2+‖x‖ := add_le_add_left (hy.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
               (sub_le_self _ (hs i)) hc.le) (by norm_num))) _
           _ ≤ A := by linarith
    rw [dist_eq_norm,ht,offset]; apply (norm_mul_le _ _).trans (mul_le_mul (?_ : ‖1-2*f i‖ ≤ C) hi (norm_nonneg _) hc.le)
    apply (norm_sub_le ..).trans _
    linarith [le_trans (norm_mul_le (2:R) (f i)) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hl (norm_nonneg (2:R)))]
  have hv i : ‖defect (f i)‖ ≤ s i ∧ ‖f i-x‖ ≤ C*(ε-s i)*2 := by
    induction i with
    | zero => simpa [f,s] using he
    | succ i ih =>
      have ha : s i ≤ ε := mul_le_of_le_one_right h (pow_le_one₀ hθ.le (by norm_num [θ]))
      have hz : s (i+1)=s i/2 := by simp only [s,pow_succ,θ]; ring
      constructor
      · rw [ht,demand,hz];
        have Ht : ‖4*(defect (f i))-3‖ ≤ ‖(4:R)‖*ε+‖(3:R)‖ := (norm_sub_le ..).trans
          (add_le_add_left ((norm_mul_le _ _).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (ih.1.trans ha) (norm_nonneg _))) _)
        apply le_trans ((norm_mul_le ..).trans (mul_le_mul Ht (le_trans (show ‖defect (f i)^2‖ ≤ ‖defect (f i)‖^2 by simp only [pow_two]; exact norm_mul_le _ _) (pow_le_pow_left₀
          (norm_nonneg (defect (f i))) ih.1 2)) (norm_nonneg _) ((norm_nonneg _).trans Ht)))
        have he := le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ha (show 0 ≤ _*ε + ‖(3:R)‖ from by positivity)) hh
        nlinarith [hs i]
      calc _ = dist (f (i+1)) x := (dist_eq_norm _ _).symm
           _ ≤ dist (f (i+1)) (f i)+dist (f i) x := dist_triangle ..
           _ ≤ _ := by rw [hz]; have hh := hb i ih.1 ih.2; rw [dist_eq_norm (f i) x]; linarith [ih.2]
  have hΘ : θ < 1 := by norm_num [θ]
  obtain ⟨y,hy⟩ := cauchySeq_tendsto_of_complete (cauchySeq_of_le_geometric θ (C*ε) hΘ (fun i => show dist (f i) (f (i+1)) ≤ _ by
    rw [dist_comm,mul_assoc]; exact hb _ (hv i).1 (hv i).2))
  have he : Tendsto s atTop (𝓝 0) := by simpa only [mul_zero] using (tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one hθ.le hΘ).const_mul ε
  refine ⟨y,hy, norm_eq_zero.mp ?_,?_⟩
  · exact tendsto_nhds_unique ((hy.pow 2 |>.sub hy).norm) (squeeze_zero (fun i => norm_nonneg _) (fun i => (hv i).1) he)
  rw [← mul_assoc]
  exact le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto' ((hy.sub_const x).norm) (show Tendsto (fun i => C*(ε-s i)*2) atTop (𝓝 (C*ε*2)) by simpa only [sub_zero] using ((he.const_sub ε).const_mul C).mul_const (2:ℝ)) (fun i => (hv i).2)
ends.conclusion: `rectify` shows that near an element of small defect the iterates of `φ` have squaring errors and a convergent geometric sum of displacements, converging to an idempotent.

lemma stable {z : R} (hz : defect z=0) (Z : ℕ → R) (ht : Tendsto Z atTop (𝓝 z)) : ∃ P : ℕ → R,
    (∀ᶠ n in atTop, Tendsto (fun i : ℕ => φ^[i] (Z n)) atTop (𝓝 (P n)) ∧ defect (P n)=0) ∧ Tendsto P atTop (𝓝 z) := by
  let A := ‖z‖+1
  obtain ⟨C,hC⟩ := exists_gt (‖(1:R)‖+‖(2:R)‖*A)
  have hc : 0 < C := by
    have hv : 0<A := by dsimp only [A]; positivity
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (by positivity) hC
  let E n := ‖defect (Z n)‖
  have he : Tendsto E atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have hv := (ht.pow 2 |>.sub ht).norm
    rw [show z^2-z=0 from hz,norm_zero] at hv; exact hv
  have hh : Tendsto (fun i => C*(E i*2)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by simpa using ((he.mul_const (2:ℝ)).const_mul C)
  have hy : ∀ᶠ i in atTop, ‖Z i‖+C*(E i*2) ≤ A := by
    apply ((ht.norm.add hh).eventually (gt_mem_nhds (?_ : ‖z‖+0 < A))).mono (fun i hi => show _ from le_of_lt hi)
    dsimp only [A]; linarith
  have hp := (he.const_mul ‖(4:R)‖ |>.add_const ‖(3:R)‖ |>.mul he)
  simp only [mul_zero,zero_add] at hp
  let e (p : ℕ) (y : R) := Tendsto (fun i : ℕ => φ^[i] (Z p)) atTop (𝓝 y) ∧ defect y=0 ∧ ‖y-Z p‖ ≤ C*(E p*2)
  have hE : ∀ᶠ i in atTop, ∃ y, e i y := (hy.and (hp.eventually (gt_mem_nhds
    (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1/2)))).mono (fun i hi => rectify A C (E i) hC _ hi.1 le_rfl (le_of_lt hi.2) hc)
  classical
  let P (n : ℕ) := if h : ∃ y, e n y then h.choose else z
  replace hE : ∀ᶠ i in atTop,e i (P i) := hE.mono fun i hi => by dsimp only [P]; rw [dif_pos hi];exact hi.choose_spec
  refine ⟨P,hE.mono (fun i hi => ⟨hi.1,hi.2.1⟩),?_⟩
  have hv : Tendsto (fun i => P i-Z i) atTop (𝓝 0) := tendsto_zero_iff_norm_tendsto_zero.mpr (squeeze_zero'
    (Eventually.of_forall fun _ => norm_nonneg _) (hE.mono fun i hi => hi.2.2) hh)
  simpa using hv.add ht
ends.conclusion: `stable` builds idempotents `P n` as limits of `φ^[i] (Z n)` with `P n → z` when `Z n → z` and `z² = z`.

lemma enough (D : I → R) (l r : I → I) (h : Relations D l r) (he : ∀ i, ‖D i‖ < 1/2) : ∀ i, D i=0 := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨y,hy,hp⟩ := Finset.exists_max_image Finset.univ (fun i => ‖D i‖) Finset.univ_nonempty
  have mt i := hp i (Finset.mem_univ i)
  have hn i j : ‖D i*D j‖ ≤ ‖D y‖^2 := (norm_mul_le _ _).trans
    (sq ‖D y‖ ▸ mul_le_mul (mt i) (mt j) (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))
  have hx : ‖D y‖ ≤ ‖D y‖^2 + ‖D y‖^2 := calc
                                                ‖D y‖ = _ := congr_arg norm (h y)
                                                _ ≤ _ := (norm_sub_le ..).trans (add_le_add (hn ..) (hn ..))
  intro i; refine norm_eq_zero.mp ?_

private theorem cov_parameter (H : S.Hierarchy) (V : DiffPlan S) (hd : V.Derivatives S)
    (U : Rotation S) (hU : Spin.Port U H.spin)
    (hs : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : Points n), x ∈ conf n → Still V U.lie x)
    (K : Ortho.Skew) (t : ℝ) : Cov U (Ortho.oneParameter K t) := by
  intro n v x hx
  let f := fun s => S.useAt S (Points.move (Ortho.oneParameter K s) x) (U.label (Ortho.oneParameter K s) ∘ v)
  have he (s : ℝ) : HasDerivAt f 0 s := by
    have hh : HasDerivAt f (angular V U.lie (U.label (Ortho.oneParameter K s) ∘ v) K
        (Points.move (Ortho.oneParameter K s) x)) s := parameterDeriv H V hd U hU K x hx v s
    rwa [hs n _ (Points.move_in _ hx) _ K] at hh
  have hc : f t = f 0 := is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero
    (fun s => (he s).differentiableAt) (fun s => (he s).deriv) t 0
  change f t = _
  rw [hc]
  unfold f
  rw [parameter_zero]
  exact cov_one hU n v x hx

theorem conserved_average (c : Conserved V H J) : Conserved V H (averageStress X J) where

    rw [average_component h, average_component h]
    exact integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun K =>
      (rotate_conserved h K J c).symmetric a b)
  real a b := calc
    _ = ∫ K : Ortho, S.conj H 4 (rotateStress X K J a b) ∂μ :=
      map_average h J (realConjugateComponent H a b)
    _ = ∫ K : Ortho, rotateStress X K J a b ∂μ :=
      integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun K =>
        (rotate_conserved h K J c).real a b)
    _ = _ := (average_component h J a b).symm
  divergence b := by
    calc
      _ = divergenceMap V b (averageStress X J) := (divergenceMap_apply V b _).symm
      _ = ∫ K : Ortho, divergenceMap V b (rotateStress X K J) ∂μ :=

      _ = ∫ _ : Ortho, (0 : S.Field (4+1)) ∂μ :=
        integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun K =>
          (divergenceMap_apply V b _).trans ((rotate_conserved h K J c).divergence b))
      _ = 0 := integral_zero _ _

      _ = ∑ j : Axis, ((Ortho.move K⁻¹ (basis b) j : ℝ) : ℂ) •

        rw [h.vector]
        simp only [map_sum, map_smul, front_apply, B', Ortho.move, M4.move_basis]
      _ = _ := by
        rw [front_apply]; exact oriented_cons p K⁻¹ hx q (d+1) (V.deriv d b B)
  rotation := by
    intro n x hx q χ w g d B
    let x' := Points.move K⁻¹ x
    let q' := X.label K⁻¹ ∘ q
    let B' := X.act d K⁻¹ B
    have hx' : x' ∈ conf (n+1) := Points.move_in K⁻¹ hx
    have w' := window_pull K w
    let g' := pullSkew K g

      (A H.spin X ⟨h.spin,h.fixes,h.group,h.signed,h.real,h.infinitesimal⟩).2 d K⁻¹ g B

      _ = fluxCore x (Fin.cons ⟨d,B⟩ q) χ (fun y => M4.move g.val (y-x 0)) (rotateStress X K J) :=
        (fluxCore_angular hx w H.smooth q B (rotateStress X K J) g).symm
      _ = fluxCore x' (Fin.cons ⟨d,B'⟩ q') (χ ∘ Ortho.move K)
          (fun y => M4.move g'.val (y-x' 0)) J := by
        rw [pull_flux h p K hx w, label_cons]
        simp_rw [pull_centered]; rfl
      _ = S.useAt S x' (Fin.cons ⟨d,X.lie d g' B'⟩ q') := by
        rw [fluxCore_angular hx' w' H.smooth, c.rotation hx' q' w']

theorem pull_flux {V : DiffPlan S} {H : S.RealSpin} {X : Rotation S}
    (h : X.Laws V H) (p : X.Oriented S) (K : Ortho) {x : Points (n+1)} (hx : x ∈ conf _)
    {χ : E4 → ℝ} (w : Window x χ) (q : Fin (n+1) → S.Tag) (W : E4 → E4) (J : S.Stress) :
    fluxCore x q χ W (rotateStress X K J) = fluxCore (Points.move K⁻¹ x) (X.label K⁻¹ ∘ q)
      (χ ∘ Ortho.move K) (fun y => Ortho.move K⁻¹ (W (Ortho.move K y))) J := by
  let x' := Points.move K⁻¹ x
  have hf (z : S.Tag) : X.label K (X.label K⁻¹ z) = z := by
    rcases z with ⟨d,v⟩
    change Sigma.mk d (X.act d K (X.act d K⁻¹ v)) = _
    rw [← h.group, mul_inv_cancel, h.fixes]
  let f := Ortho.motion K
  unfold fluxCore
  apply congrArg Neg.neg
  rw [← MeasurePreserving.integral_comp f.measurePreserving f.toHomeomorph.measurableEmbedding]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [(Set.finite_range x'.ofLp).countable.ae_notMem (volume : Measure E4)] with y hy
  have hxy : Points.cons y x' ∈ conf _ :=
    Fin.cons_injective_of_injective hy (show Injective x'.ofLp from Points.move_in K⁻¹ hx)
  have he : Points.move K (Points.cons y x') = Points.cons (f y) x := by
    ext1 i
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
    · simp [Points.cons, f]
    · simp [Points.cons, x']
  change front (Points.cons (f y) x) q 4
    (contractStress (gradVec χ (Ortho.move K y)) (W (Ortho.move K y)) (rotateStress X K J)) = _
  rw [contract_rotate, front_apply, front_apply, gradVec_pull K w.1]
  have orient := oriented_cons p K hxy (X.label K⁻¹ ∘ q) 4
    (contractStress (Ortho.move K⁻¹ (gradVec χ (Ortho.move K y)))
      (Ortho.move K⁻¹ (W (Ortho.move K y))) J)
  rw [show X.label K ∘ X.label K⁻¹ ∘ q = q from funext fun i => hf _, he] at orient
  exact orient
ends.conclusion: The flux of `rotateStress X K J` in window `χ` equals the flux of `J` in the window `χ ∘ move K` at the moved configuration.

lemma contract (H : S.Hierarchy) (t) (p : Voice L a) : ‖timed X t p‖ ≤ ‖X.stems p‖ := by
  let d i := ‖timed X i p‖
  have ht : BddAbove (Set.range d) := by
    obtain ⟨A,hA⟩ := enough X H p; exact ⟨A,by rintro _ ⟨y,rfl⟩; exact hA y⟩
  let c := ⨆ i : ℝ≥0, d i
  have he i : d i ≤ c := le_ciSup ht _
  have hp : 0 ≤ d t := norm_nonneg _
  have hh (i) : d i ^ 2 ≤ ‖X.stems p‖ * c := by
    change ‖timed X i p‖^2 ≤ _
    rw [sq_key X, symmetrical X H.translations]
    exact (norm_inner_le_norm ..).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (he _) (norm_nonneg _))
  let A := ‖X.stems p‖*c
  have hA : 0 ≤ A := le_trans (sq_nonneg _) (hh t)
  have h₀ := hp.trans (he t)
  have hw : c ≤ √A := ciSup_le fun i => (Real.le_sqrt (norm_nonneg (timed X i p)) hA).mpr (hh i)
  apply (he t).trans
  have hq := sq_le_sq₀ h₀ (Real.sqrt_nonneg A) |>.2 hw
  rw [Real.sq_sqrt hA] at hq
  dsimp only [A] at hq
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (X.stems p)]
ends.conclusion: `‖timed X t p‖ ≤ ‖X.stems p‖`: the time translates contract.

structure Semigroup (H : Hilbert) (a : Axis) where

  time t s : E (t+s)=(E t).comp (E s)
  shrinks t : ‖E t‖ ≤ 1
  sym t : (E t).adjoint = E t
  uZero : U 0=ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ _
  space t s : U (t+s)=(U t).comp (U s)
  unitary t v : ‖U t v‖=‖v‖
  independent t s : (E t).comp (U s)=(U s).comp (E t)
  continuousE v : Continuous (fun t => E t v)
  continuousU v : Continuous (fun t => U t v)

lemma implement (H : S.Hierarchy) : ∃ C : Chamber S a, C.GNS = X := by
  choose E hE hP using fun (t : ℝ≥0) => X.by_bound (fun v => X.plant (travel v t)) 1 zero_le_one (by
    intro g; rw [one_mul]; exact contract X H t g)
  choose U hU hW using fun (x : Cross a) => X.by_bound (fun v => X.plant (over v x)) 1 zero_le_one (by
    intro g; rw [one_mul]; exact (safe X x H g).le)
  have es t : (E t).adjoint=E t := by
    apply X.by_bud; intro v
    refine X.whole.eq_of_inner_left ℂ fun f => ?_
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_left]
    -- linearity on all sums; compare singles
    induction f using Finsupp.induction_linear with
    | zero => simp
    | add f g hf hg => -- extract v form after adj rewrite
      simp only [map_add, inner_add_right,hf,hg]
    | single i c =>
      simp only [Kernel.Gram.stems,Finsupp.linearCombination_single,map_smul,
        inner_smul_right,hP,X.measure,sym_time H.translations]
  have hu : U 0=ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ X.H := X.by_bud fun i => by rw [hW,pause]; rfl
  have hv (x y) : U (x+y)=(U x).comp (U y) := by
    apply X.by_bud; intro i; simp [hW, parallel, add_comm x y]
  let B : Semigroup X.H a := {
    E := E
    U := U
    eZero := X.by_bud fun i => by rw [hP,done]; rfl
    sym := es
    uZero := hu
    space := hv
    shrinks := hE
    time := fun x y => X.by_bud fun i => by simp [hP,add_comm x y]
    independent := fun t y => X.by_bud fun i => by simp [hP,hW]
    unitary := by
      intro t p
      have ht (t : Cross a) (p) : ‖U t p‖ ≤ ‖p‖ := ((U t).le_opNorm p).trans
        (mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg _) (hU _))
      refine le_antisymm (ht _ _) ?_
      have he := ht (-t) (U t p)
      rw [← ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,← hv,neg_add_cancel,hu] at he
      exact he
    continuousE := strong X (D := X.H) hE fun i => by simp_rw [hP]; exact contE X H i
    continuousU := strong X (D := X.H) hU fun i => by simp_rw [hW]; exact contU X H i
  }
  exact ⟨⟨X,B,fun t v => (hP t v).symm,fun x v => (hW x v).symm⟩,rfl⟩
ends.conclusion: A `Chamber` exists on any Schwinger functional: the `E t` and `U x` are built as bounded operators with these laws.

lemma against (A B : V→ₗ[ℂ] V) (X : V →ₗ[ℂ] H) (D : ℝ) (h : 0<D)
    (hp : ∀ v w, inner ℂ (X (A v)) (X w)=inner ℂ (X v) (X (B w)))
    (ht : ∀ v:V, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ n:ℕ, ‖X (((B ∘ₗ A)^n) v)‖ ≤ C*D^(2*n)) (v : V) :
    ‖X (A v)‖ ≤ D*‖X v‖ := by

    change inner ℂ (X _) (X (B _))=_

      conv_rhs => rw [pow_succ]
      conv_lhs => rw [pow_succ']
      rw [show (T*T^n) w=T ((T^n) w) from rfl, hh, ih];rfl

  have he : BddAbove (range d) := by
    refine ⟨C, fun c he => ?_⟩; obtain ⟨i,rfl⟩ := he

  let s := ⨆ i, d i

  have hz n : d n ^ 2 ≤ ‖X v‖ * s := by
    have hi : ‖inner ℂ (X v) (X ((T^(n+n)) v))‖= ‖X ((T^n) v)‖^2 := by
      rw [pow_add,Module.End.mul_apply, hw,inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K]; simp
    calc _ = ‖inner ℂ (X v) (X ((T^(n+n)) v))‖/D^(2*(n+n)) := by unfold d; rw [hi,div_pow, Nat.mul_add, pow_add, pow_two (D^_)]
