             apply (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (norm_inner_le_norm _ _) (pow_nonneg h.le _)).trans (le_of_eq ?_); unfold d; ring
         _ ≤ _ := by gcongr; exact hr _

  have hu : s ≤ ‖X v‖ := by
    have hx : s ≤ √(‖X v‖*s) := ciSup_le fun i => (Real.le_sqrt (Ht i) (by positivity)).mpr (hz i)

  apply (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)).1

  have hr : ‖X ((T^1) v)‖ ≤ ‖X v‖*D^(2*1) := (div_le_iff₀ (pow_pos h _)).1 ((hr 1).trans hu)

  exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hr (norm_nonneg _)).trans_eq (by ring)

lemma bit (H : R.Out) (x : P.algebra) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (h : Tall P x t) (i : R.X) :
    ‖R.character i x‖ ≤ t := by
  classical
  have ht' (j n) : R.character j (((star x*x)^n:P.algebra))=(↑(‖R.character j x‖^(2*n)):ℂ) := by
    rw [map_pow,map_mul,map_star,pow_mul,Complex.ofReal_pow -- direction
        ]
    congr 1
    change starRingEnd ℂ _ * _=_
    rw [mul_comm, Complex.mul_conj,Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
  let f (i) := ‖R.character i x‖
  have hg n : (∫ i, f i^(2*n) ∂R.μ) ≤ t^(2*n) := by
    have he := h n; rw [← H.ground] at he
    simp_rw [ht',integral_complex_ofReal,Complex.ofReal_re] at he; exact he
  by_contra! hv
  obtain ⟨p,hp,hv⟩ := exists_between hv
  let Q := {x | p<f x}
  have he : Continuous f := (H.weak x).norm
  have hu : IsOpen Q := isOpen_lt continuous_const he
  have ho := H.support; have h' := H.normalized
  let c := R.μ.real Q
  have hc : 0<c := by apply ENNReal.toReal_pos (mu_ne ho Q hu ⟨i,hv⟩) (measure_ne_top R.μ Q)
  have hz := ht.trans_lt hp
  have hf n : c ≤ ((t/p)^2)^n := by
    let g (i) := f i ^ (2*n)
    have hx : Integrable g R.μ := (he.pow _).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (HasCompactSupport.of_compactSpace _)
    rw [← pow_mul,div_pow]
    refine (le_div_iff₀ (pow_pos hz _)).2 ?_
    calc
      _ = ∫ _ in Q,(p^(2*n):ℝ) ∂R.μ := by simp [c]
      _ ≤ ∫ i in Q,g i ∂R.μ := setIntegral_mono_on (integrable_const _) hx.integrableOn hu.measurableSet fun j hj =>
          pow_le_pow_left₀ hz.le (show p < f j from hj).le _
      _ ≤ ∫ i, g i ∂R.μ := setIntegral_le_integral hx (ae_of_all _ fun i => pow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _)
      _ ≤ t^(2*n) := hg n
  have hq : t/p < 1 := div_lt_one hz |>.2 hp
  have hx := div_nonneg ht hz.le
  exact hc.not_ge (ge_of_tendsto' (tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one (sq_nonneg _) (by exact pow_lt_one₀ hx hq (by omega))) hf)
where mu_ne (h : R.μ.IsOpenPosMeasure) (q : Set R.X) (a : IsOpen q) (b : q.Nonempty) : R.μ q≠0 := IsOpenPosMeasure.open_pos q a b

theorem lift_detect (hi : a.Out) {v} (h : a.receives D v) (hD : D.Symmetric) (hp : D.respects S) : D.null d=S.null d := by
  let U k := X.basis.constr ℂ fun i => Y.later k i
  have he k : S.project d ∘ₗ U k= X.basis.constr ℂ fun i => S.project _ (Y.later k i) := X.basis.ext fun i => by simp [U]
  let f (k : ℕ) : (standard C).Field d→L[ℂ] (Fin X.amount → ℂ) := LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap
    ((LinearMap.pi (probe' (D := D) Y k)).comp ((D.project d).comp (U k)))
  let F : (standard C).Field d →L[ℂ] (Fin X.amount→ℂ) := LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (LinearMap.pi (plot (X := X)))
  have hg k i j : f k (X.basis i) j=probe' Y k j (D.project d (Y.later k i)) := by simp [f,U]
  have hh i : Tendsto (fun n => f n (X.basis i)) atTop (𝓝 (F (X.basis i))) := by
    refine tendsto_pi_nhds.mpr fun j => ?_
    simp_rw [hg, show F (X.basis i) j=_ from plott j (X.basis i)]
    exact result Y Q P a H hi h hD j i
  have hx : Injective F := fun q p h => X.full (show _ from by
    change (fun i => (X.row i).tests _ _ q)=fun i => (X.row i).tests _ _ p; simp_rw [← plott]; exact h)
  obtain ⟨k,hk,Hk⟩ := (((converge X.basis _ _ hh).eventually (ContinuousLinearMap.isOpen_injective
      |>.mem_nhds hx)).and Q.span).exists
  change Injective (f k) at hk
  suffices hv : Surjective (S.project d ∘ₗ U k) by
    refine le_antisymm (fun i H' => ?_) (hp d)
    obtain ⟨w,hw⟩ := hv (S.project _ i)
    have ht : U k w - i ∈ D.null d := hp _ ((Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).1 (show S.project d _=0 from
      by rw [map_sub]; exact sub_eq_zero.mpr hw))
    have he := (D.null d).add_mem ht H'
    rw [sub_add_cancel] at he
    apply (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).mp
    change S.project d _=_
    rw [← hw]; suffices w=0 by rw [this,map_zero]
    apply hk; rw [map_zero]
    change (LinearMap.pi (probe' Y k)) (D.project d (U k w))=0
    rw [show D.project d (U k w)=0 from (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).mpr he,map_zero]
  apply LinearMap.range_eq_top.mp; rw [eq_top_iff,← Hk,Submodule.span_le]; rintro _ ⟨i,rfl⟩
  exact ⟨X.basis i,by simp [U]⟩

private theorem saturated {F G : ℂ → ℂ} {C D : ℝ} (hF : Air F C) (hG : Air G D)
    (h : ∀ x : ℝ, F (x:ℂ)=G (- (x:ℂ))) : ∀ z∈high, F z=F 0 := by
  classical
  let L : ℂ → ℂ := high.piecewise F (fun z => G (-z))
  let v := {x : ℂ| x.im ≤ 0}
  have he : EqOn L F high := piecewise_eqOn _ _ _
  have hl : EqOn L (fun z => G (-z)) v := by
    intro z hp; by_cases hZ : z.im=0
    · rw [he (show z∈high from hZ.symm.le),show z = (↑z.re:ℂ) from Complex.ext rfl (by simpa)]
      exact h z.re
    unfold L; rw [piecewise_eq_of_notMem _ _ _ (show z ∉ high from fun hh => hZ (le_antisymm hp hh))]
  have hc : Continuous L := by
    have hF' := hF.connects.congr he
    have hG' : ContinuousOn L v := ((hG.connects.comp continuous_neg.continuousOn (fun z hz =>
      show 0≤(-z).im by simpa using (show z.im≤0 from hz))) : ContinuousOn (fun z => G (-z)) v).congr hl
    apply continuousOn_univ.mp
    rw [show (@univ ℂ)=high∪v from by ext z; exact ⟨fun _ => le_total 0 z.im,fun _ => trivial⟩]
    exact hF'.union_of_isClosed hG' highC (isClosed_le continuous_im continuous_const)
  have hx : DifferentiableOn ℂ L loft := hF.straight.congr (he.mono Paley.subset)
  have hu : DifferentiableOn ℂ L {z : ℂ| z.im < 0} :=
    (hG.straight.comp (f:=-id) (differentiable_id.neg.differentiableOn) (fun z hz => show 0<(-z).im by simpa using (show z.im<0 from hz))).congr
      (fun z hz => hl (show z.im≤0 from (show z.im<0 from hz).le))
  have hp := paste hc hx hu
  have hh : Bornology.IsBounded (Set.range L) := (Metric.isBounded_closedBall (x:= (0:ℂ)) (r:=max C D)).subset (by
    rintro _ ⟨z,rfl⟩
    rw [mem_closedBall_zero_iff]; rcases le_total 0 z.im with H|H
    · exact (he H).symm ▸ le_trans (hF.bounded z H) (le_max_left C D)
    rw [hl H]; exact (hG.bounded (-z) (by simpa [high] using H)).trans (le_max_right C D))
  exact fun z hz => (he hz).symm.trans ((hp.apply_eq_apply_of_bounded hh z 0).trans (he (by simp [high])))
ends.conclusion: Two bounded continuous functions on the closed upper half-plane, holomorphic inside and equal as `F x = G (-x)` on the line, give a bounded entire function (`paste`, Morera) that is constant (Liouville).
